• S'engager largement avec des KOL externes, des enquêteurs cliniques et des réseaux pour valider le potentiel des actifs, comprendre les conceptions d'essais et les paramètres cliniques et anticiper la dynamique concurrentielle. ​
• Maintenir une connaissance approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins et des paysages concurrentiels pour éclairer les priorités d'approvisionnement et la stratégie de transaction. ​
• Mener une diligence raisonnable interfonctionnelle pour les actifs en phase de développement avancé, en coordonnant les évaluations cliniques, réglementaires, commerciales et d'accès au marché pour soutenir les décisions de gouvernance. ​
• Collaborer étroitement avec le BD et les responsables régionaux de l'écosystème pour faire progresser les opportunités hautement prioritaires grâce à la négociation et à la conclusion d'accords, garantissant un transfert et une exécution fluides. ​
• Représenter le TA à l'externe, diriger les activités d'approvisionnement lors de conférences spécialisées et établir des relations avec les communautés pharmaceutique, biotechnologique et clinique. ​ Exigences de qualifications et d'expérience ​
• Plus de 15 ans dans le domaine biopharmaceutique avec une expérience significative en développement clinique, en innovation externe ou en développement commercial. ​
• Diplôme d'études supérieures requis (MD, PhD ou équivalent). ​
• Expertise clinique approfondie dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de l'hématologie ou des maladies cardiovasculaires/rénales. ​
• Expérience avérée en matière de recherche et de conclusion d'accords à un stade avancé et d'engagement avec des KOL et des réseaux cliniques. ​
• Solide compréhension des voies réglementaires, de l'accès au marché et des normes de soins compétitives. ​ L'échelle salariale de base attendue pour ce poste au moment de l'embauche est de 263 000 $ à 328 000 $. Veuillez noter que cette échelle salariale reflète le salaire de base minimum et maximum que CSL s'attend à payer pour ce poste chez Waltham MA au moment de cette publication. Le salaire de base individuel d'un candidat retenu est déterminé par ses qualifications, son niveau de compétence, son expérience, ses compétences et d'autres facteurs pertinents. En plus du salaire de base, la rémunération totale pour ce rôle peut également inclure une rémunération incitative et des actions. #LI-HYBRID À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un leader mondial des biothérapeutiques animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. jobs.title: Associate Director, Statistical Programming (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Position Purpose
The Associate Director, Statistical Programming provides leadership and expertise in driving the development and maintenance of the CSL statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations. The individual will work closely with the Director, Statistical Programming to ensure all assigned Statistical Programming tasks are managed to completion. Work closely with Statisticians to ensure that deliverables provided by internal resources or outside providers (CROs; FSP providers) are accurate and aligned with CSL standards.
This individual may manage a Therapeutic Areas (TA) or programs within or across TAs working with the Statistics TA lead to ensure all work required in the TA is completed within the project timelines with high quality.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Working with the Director, Programming to assess upcoming activities and resulting resource needs and ensure high quality, timely, delivery of assigned projects. Ensure realistic project planning.
• Oversee the CRO delivery or manage the in-house programming of data sets, outputs, and DDT files of clinical trials and integrated analysis.
• Plans and leads the design and implementation of complex specifications and programs for applications designed to analyze and report complex clinical trial data in CDISC format.
• Coordinating the oversight or in-house programming of exploratory analyses, analyses to support secondary publications, response to regulatory requests, or other adhoc requests.
• Mentors programmers allocated to assigned projects and provides feedback to managers of these team members as needed.
• As a project or program leader ensures compliance with programming process and strategy to facilitate accurate and timely programming.
• Test and implement state of the art programming methods and tools to the organization and drive automation of delivery, including AI.
Education
• BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related area with relevant experience
• Other degrees and certifications considered if commensurate with related programming experience
Experience
• At least 9 years of experience in either clinical programming and/or statistical programming, within the CRO/pharmaceutical environment using SAS Software.
• Comprehensive understanding of clinical programming and/or statistical programming processes and standards.
• Advanced Experiences with statistical programming using the SAS software including development and use of SAS Macros.
• Advanced knowledge in CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM).
• Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines.
• Experience in working in cross-functional, multicultural and international clinical trial teams.

Competencies
• Coding in SAS, including SAS macro language
• Interest and/or experience in expanding beyond SAS as the primary programming delivery tool
• Experience in and/or passion for automatization of routine programming tasks
• Broad knowledge of clinical development and processes
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written in English), comfortable around senior management
• Ability to collaboratively work in matrix environment
• A solutions oriented mindset
• Fluency in technical requirements for CDISC compatible datasets and DDT files
• Presentations of programming techniques at professional conferences is a plus

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation

• In qualità di leader di progetto o programma, garantisce il rispetto del processo e della strategia di programmazione per facilitare una programmazione accurata e tempestiva.
• Testare e implementare metodi e strumenti di programmazione all'avanguardia per l'organizzazione e promuovere l'automazione della consegna, inclusa l'intelligenza artificiale. Istruzione
• Laurea in informatica, matematica, statistica o area correlata con esperienza rilevante
• Altri titoli e certificazioni considerati se commisurati alla relativa esperienza di programmazione Esperienza
• Almeno 9 anni di esperienza nella programmazione clinica e/o nella programmazione statistica, all'interno dell'ambiente CRO/farmaceutico utilizzando il software SAS.
• Comprensione completa dei processi e degli standard di programmazione clinica e/o di programmazione statistica.
• Esperienze avanzate con la programmazione statistica utilizzando il software SAS incluso lo sviluppo e l'uso di macro SAS.
• Conoscenza avanzata degli standard CDISC (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM).
• Comprovata capacità di lavorare in modo efficace sia in modo indipendente che in un contesto di squadra e di raggiungere gli obiettivi prefissati gestendo le proprie tempistiche.
• Esperienza di lavoro in team di sperimentazioni cliniche interfunzionali, multiculturali e internazionali. Competenze
• Codifica in SAS, incluso il linguaggio macro SAS
• Interesse e/o esperienza nell'espansione oltre SAS come strumento primario di distribuzione della programmazione
• Esperienza e/o passione per l'automazione di attività di programmazione di routine
• Ampia conoscenza dello sviluppo clinico e dei processi
• Forti capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione (verbali e scritte in inglese), a proprio agio con il senior management
• Capacità di lavorare in modo collaborativo in un ambiente a matrice
• Una mentalità orientata alle soluzioni
• Ottima conoscenza dei requisiti tecnici per set di dati compatibili con CDISC e file DDT
• Presentazioni di tecniche di programmazione a livello professionale le conferenze sono un vantaggio Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale nel campo della bioterapia guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite umane. Concentrati nel soddisfare le esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le tecnologie più recenti, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con patologie nelle aree terapeutiche immunologica, ematologica, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e dei trapianti. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ​​ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Business Operations Lead to drive local Commercial Excellence initiatives at CSL in Switzerland, with a dedicated focus on Sales Force Effectiveness, CRM ownership, and integrated account management.

The role further strengthens data-driven decision-making through aligned reporting (e.g. Power BI) and the use of local market research to support strategic planning. It also builds digital capabilities and omnichannel customer engagement across teams. This role integrates and develops the Customer Service function, including processes, systems (e.g. SAP), positioning Customer Service as a competitive advantage.

The position ensures close collaboration with above-market and DACH teams, oversees congresses, events, and educational platforms, and contributes as a member of the country leadership team with strong cross-functional team building.

In this position you will be directly reporting to the General Manager CSL Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as a cross-functional team lead and member of the Country Leadership Team

• Drive local Sales Force Effectiveness, Analytics, and Strategic Insights in close collaboration with local teams and above-market/DACH functions

• Lead the digital and omnichannel (OC) engagement approach, including processes, frameworks, and cross-functional projects in coordination with BU and DACH teams

• Oversee congress and event management for CSL Switzerland

• Integrate and further develop Customer Service as a key business capability

Main Tasks

Leadership

• Contribute as a Country Leadership Team member and actively support the development of the CSL Switzerland culture

• Act as a change management lead in a dynamic, evolving matrix environment

• Lead and develop a team of up to 11 headcounts, including a management layer

CSL CH Commercial Excellence: Sales Force Effectiveness, Analytics and Strategic Insights

• Localize segmentation and targeting across all sales lines, aligned with DACH standards

• Localize goal setting and incentive calculations in alignment with DACH frameworks

• Own and manage the local CRM system, including harmonization initiatives

• Lead rollouts and trainings for local teams (e.g. Smart 2.0, segmentation)

• Drive Integrated Account Management in close collaboration with cross-functional partners

• Localize and manage BI solutions, including data warehouse, data models, Power BI, and reporting

• Generate local insights in collaboration with DACH and global teams

• Conduct local market research to support brand strategies

• Localize patient flow models and forecasts based on global tools and methodologies

• Lead local opportunity screening and business case development

CSL CH Customer Service

• Integrate Customer Service into one unified CSL Switzerland Customer Service team

• Drive system harmonization, including SAP implementation

• Lead Customer Supply Management and develop Customer Service as a competitive advantage

• Manage key customers, including hospitals and wholesalers, on a regular basis

CSL CH Digital enablement

• Build and implement a local CSL Switzerland framework for digital and omnichannel engagement across Marketing, Sales, and Medical

• Support execution of the digital and OC engagement strategy

• Develop and manage an integrated local website strategy in compliance with internal SOPs

• Work closely with the DACH Digital Enablement Lead

Congress & Event Management

• Develop and implement a CSL Switzerland framework for congress and event management

• Build and continuously evolve CSL Switzerland’s visibility concept at congresses and events

• Provide support to Business Units and functions

• Lead transparency reporting and ensure full compliance with internal SOPs

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Life Sciences, or a related field

• Minimum of 8 years’ experience in Sales Force Effectiveness, Marketing, Sales, and complex project management within the pharmaceutical indu

jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The Head of Global Regulatory Affairs CMC - Network Strategy & Operation is responsible for:

Partnering closely with global and regional Global Regulatory Affairs colleagues, as well as Global Operations stakeholders, to address regulatory strategy challenges and deliver innovative, timely regulatory CMC solutions that meet evolving regulatory and compliance requirements.

Supporting digital innovation, enabling capital project initiatives, and managing strategic external partnerships by coordinating and aligning regulatory CMC strategies and activities across the enterprise.

Ensuring operational alignment of Global Regulatory Affairs CMC activities and processes with R&D Global Regulatory Affairs and within Global Operations business needs.

This role promotes strong cross-functional collaboration and effective communication across Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs, and other relevant CSL business functions to drive alignment and support CSL’s strategic business objectives.

Main 
• Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Develop global regulatory CMC strategies for enterprise-wide CAPEX and compliance projects through collaboration with functional leaders in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations, and other business functions.

Assess and facilitate the use of digital innovation for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, including AI/ML applications that manage or support regulatory submission, notification, assessment and intelligence activities. Collaborate with Procurement, IT, external vendors, and R&D Global Regulatory Affairs to implement next-generation solutions that enhance the generation of regulatory strategies and execution of regulatory operations. Define and monitor KPIs to measure impact of digital initiatives on operational efficiency indicators.

Manage relationships with outsourcing vendors to support global regulatory CMC activities. Serve as contact for external partners, coordinating deliverables, timelines, and compliance across multiple projects and geographies. Monitor performance, quality, KPIs, and regulatory readiness of outsourced operations, driving continuous improvement and risk mitigation strategies.

Monitor, interpret, and communicate evolving global CMC regulations (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, etc.). Ensure timely dissemination of regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders and integration into strategic planning.

Coordinate key regulatory CMC activities for the Global Regulatory Affairs CMC organization, including change control, due diligence (for potential acquisitions, licensing, and partnerships), template management for quality CTD sections, deviation support, inspection support, and others.

Support the collaboration with CSL’s Corporate & External Affairs organization to support legislative and statutory initiatives to allow CSL to take an active leadership role in shaping policy and regulatory frameworks that impact the development, registration, and life-cycle management of plasma-derived therapies.

Support the development of strategic and tactical plans for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, advising senior leadership on regulatory requirements and their implications for project timelines, compliance, and business strategy. Contribute to the evaluation of new business opportunities in collaboration with development teams.

Ensure regulatory policies and procedures are developed and implemented in accordance with applicable international standards and requirements.

Support the the creation and execution of regulatory policies, processes, and SOPs that meet global regulatory requirements while driving operational efficiency and effectiveness across Global Operations and its stakeholder network.

Support the execution of the outsourcing of regulatory activities, including performance monitoring and quality assurance, to ensure timely and compliant delivery of services aligned with business and regulatory requir

Principali
• Responsabilità e responsabilità Sviluppare strategie CMC di regolamentazione globale per i progetti di conformità a livello aziendale e CAPEX attraverso la collaborazione con leader funzionali in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations e altre funzioni aziendali. Monitorare le prestazioni, la qualità, i KPI e la disponibilità normativa di operazioni outsourced, guidando strategie di miglioramento continuo e mitigazione dei rischi. Monitorare, interpretare e comunicare le normative CMC globali in evoluzione (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, ecc.). Assicurare la diffusione tempestiva dell'intelligenza normativa agli stakeholder interni e l'integrazione nella pianificazione strategica. Coordinare le attività CMC di regolamentazione chiave per l'organizzazione Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, tra cui il controllo dei cambiamenti, due diligence (per potenziali acquisizioni, licenze e partenariati), la gestione dei modelli per le sezioni CTD di qualità, il supporto di deviazione, il supporto di ispezione e altri. Sostenere la collaborazione con l’organizzazione Corporate & External Affairs di CSL per sostenere iniziative legislative e statutarie per consentire alla CSL di assumere un ruolo di leadership attivo nella definizione di politiche e quadri normativi che influiscono sullo sviluppo, la registrazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle terapie basate sul plasma. Sostenere lo sviluppo di piani strategici e tattici per Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, consigliando la leadership senior sui requisiti normativi e le loro implicazioni per i tempi di progetto, la conformità e la strategia aziendale. Contribuisci alla valutazione di nuove opportunità di business in collaborazione con i team di sviluppo. Assicurarsi che le politiche e le procedure di regolamentazione siano sviluppate e implementate in conformità con le norme e i requisiti internazionali applicabili. Sostenere la creazione e l'esecuzione di politiche, processi e SOP normativi globali che soddisfano i requisiti normativi globali, guidando l'efficienza operativa e l'efficacia su Global Operations e sulla sua rete di stakeholder. Sostenere l'esecuzione dell'outsourcing delle attività regolamentari, compreso il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e la garanzia della qualità, per garantire la consegna tempestiva e conforme dei servizi allineati con le esigenze aziendali e regolamentari

Collaborer avec Approvisionnement, TI, fournisseurs externes et R-D Affaires réglementaires mondiales pour mettre en oeuvre des solutions de nouvelle génération qui améliorent la production de stratégies réglementaires et l'exécution des opérations réglementaires. Surveiller, interpréter et communiquer l'évolution de la réglementation mondiale sur le MCC (ADF, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, etc.). Assurer la diffusion en temps opportun des renseignements réglementaires aux intervenants internes et l'intégration à la planification stratégique. Coordonner les principales activités de réglementation du CMC pour l'organisation Affaires réglementaires mondiales du CMC, y compris le contrôle du changement, la diligence raisonnable (pour les acquisitions potentielles, les licences et les partenariats), la gestion des modèles pour les sections de qualité du CTD, le soutien aux écarts, le soutien à l'inspection, etc. Appuyer la collaboration avec l'organisation des Affaires corporatives et extérieures de la CSL afin d'appuyer les initiatives législatives et législatives afin de permettre à la CSL de jouer un rôle de leadership actif dans l'élaboration des politiques et des cadres réglementaires qui influent sur le développement, l'enregistrement et la gestion du cycle de vie des thérapies à base de plasma. Appuyer l'élaboration de plans stratégiques et tactiques pour les Affaires réglementaires mondiales MCC, conseiller les cadres supérieurs sur les exigences réglementaires et leurs répercussions sur les échéanciers, la conformité et la stratégie opérationnelle des projets. Contribuer à l'évaluation des nouvelles possibilités d'affaires en collaboration avec les équipes de développement. Veiller à ce que les politiques et procédures réglementaires soient élaborées et mises en oeuvre conformément aux normes et aux exigences internationales applicables. Appuyer la création et l'exécution de politiques, processus et SOP réglementaires qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires mondiales tout en favorisant l'efficience et l'efficacité opérationnelles dans l'ensemble des opérations mondiales et de son réseau d'intervenants. Appuyer l'exécution de l'externalisation des activités réglementaires, y compris la surveillance du rendement et l'assurance de la qualité, afin d'assurer la prestation en temps voulu et conforme des services conformément aux exigences des entreprises et de la réglementation

jobs.description:
Responsible for leading the successful operational execution of global, cross-functional Tech Ops projects of strategic importance to CSL’s product portfolio, ensuring delivery against defined scope, timelines, budget, and quality requirements.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Support the execution of cross-functional project plans in alignment with defined project strategy and objectives

• Translate project strategy into detailed operational plans, including scope, timelines, resource plans, and deliverables

• Drive day-to-day project management activities across global, matrixed teams to ensure timely and quality delivery

• Develop, maintain, and control project documentation, including schedules, resource forecasts, budgets, and risk registers

• Monitor project performance against plan (timeline, budget, scope) and proactively implement corrective actions where required

• Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate critical topics in a structured and timely manner

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information in project management systems, ensuring transparency and traceability of decisions, actions, and changes

• Analyze critical path, evaluate scenarios, and challenge assumptions to enhance robustness and predictability of project plans

• Prepare high-quality, concise project updates and reports for senior stakeholders

• Coordinate cross-functional alignment and ensure effective communication across stakeholders

• Support continuous improvement of project management practices, tools, and processes

• Provide informal guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced project managers or team members

Qualifications & Experience

• Required: Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Preferred: Advanced degree (MSc, PhD) or MBA

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent preferred

• 8+ years of experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry

• 3–5 years of experience managing cross-functional projects in a global, matrixed environment

• Solid understanding of drug development, manufacturing, and Tech Ops processes

• Demonstrated track record of delivering projects on time, within budget, and meeting quality expectations

• Strong problem-solving, organizational, and planning skills

• Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence without authority

• Ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization

• Proficient in project management tools and systems (e.g., Microsoft Project or equivalent)

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand

Responsabile per la riuscita dell’esecuzione operativa dei progetti Tech Ops globali e multifunzionali di importanza strategica per il portafoglio prodotti della CSL, garantendo la consegna contro i requisiti definiti di portata, tempi, budget e qualità. Responsabilità e responsabilità
• Sostenere l'esecuzione di piani di progetto interfunzionali in allineamento con la strategia e gli obiettivi del progetto definiti
• Tradurre la strategia di progetto in piani operativi dettagliati, tra cui la portata, le linee temporali, i piani delle risorse e i materiali di consegna
• Guidare attività di gestione del progetto quotidiane in team globali, matrici per garantire la consegna tempestiva e di qualità
• Sviluppare, mantenere e controllare la documentazione del progetto, compresi gli orari, le previsioni delle risorse, i bilanci e i registri dei rischi
• Monitorare le prestazioni del progetto contro il piano (linea temporale, bilancio, ambito) e implementare proattivamente azioni correttive laddove necessario
• Identificare, valutare e gestire i rischi, i problemi e le dipendenze; escalare argomenti critici in modo strutturato e tempestivo
• Mantenere informazioni di progetto accurate e aggiornate nei sistemi di gestione dei progetti, garantendo trasparenza e tracciabilità delle decisioni, delle azioni e dei cambiamenti
• Analizzare il percorso critico, valutare gli scenari e sfidare le ipotesi per migliorare la robustezza e la prevedibilità dei piani di progetto
• Preparare gli aggiornamenti e i report dei progetti concisi di alta qualità per gli stakeholder senior
• Coordinare l'allineamento interfunzionale e garantire una comunicazione efficace tra gli stakeholder
• Sostenere il miglioramento continuo delle pratiche, degli strumenti e dei processi di gestione dei progetti
• Fornire una guida informale e una condivisione delle conoscenze a manager di progetto meno esperti o membri del team Qualifiche e esperienza
• Obbligatorio: Laurea in Scienze, Ingegneria o un campo correlato
• Preferito: Laurea Avanzata (MSc, PhD) o MBA
• Certificazione Professionale (PMP) o equivalente preferito
• 8+ anni di esperienza nel settore della biotecnologia o farmaceutica
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti interfunzionali in un ambiente globale e matrice
• Solida comprensione dei processi di sviluppo, produzione e Tech Ops
• Regime di traccia dimostrata della fornitura di progetti in tempo, all'interno del bilancio e delle aspettative di qualità
• Forte capacità di problem solving, organizzativa e di pianificazione
• Efficace capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con capacità di influenzare senza autorità
• Capacità di operare efficacemente in un'organizzazione complessa e matrice
• Proficiente di strumenti e sistemi di gestione dei progetti (ad esempio, Microsoft Project o equivalente) Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. jobs.title: Senior Scientist (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Researches and develops innovative medicines to address unmet medical needs, from early discovery through clinical trials to commercialization. It ensures that all products meet the highest clinical safety standards and comply with global regulatory requirements. The role involves analyzing complex data, managing research processes, and maintaining technical documentation and systems. It also includes designing and implementing experimental and operational processes to support efficient product development and informed decision-making. In addition, the position leads projects and cross-functional teams, overseeing portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Finally, it contributes to the development and optimization of manufacturing processes to enable efficient, scalable, and compliant production.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provides high quality scientific expertise in applying technology platforms to R&D

• Contributes to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments

• Coaches junior scientists and contributes to team development

• Manages projects/processes with limited supervision and ensures scientific rigor

• Collaborates cross-functionally to meet project milestones

• Works together with and provide expertise to other team members in order to achieve specified research project objectives within defined time parameters

Your skills and experience

• PhD preferred or Master’s degree in a relevant field

• Minimum 3 years of industry or academic experience

• Troubleshooting complex experiments

• Guiding junior staff and managing project timelines

• Aligning research with broader goals

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

Provide process technology leadership with a focus on aseptic processing. The position ensures robust process definition, system ownership, and ongoing manufacturing support for aseptic equipment operations, fostering consistency and innovation in design and technology execution globally.

Key 
• Responsibilities

Design Element

Establish and maintain appropriate engineering design standards to ensure consistency across all CapEx projects.

Develop and manage a knowledge management program to ensure all design content is available and understood globally and at site levels.

Lead conceptual and detailed design phases for Tier 1 capital projects, ensuring compliance with cGMP, FDA, EMA, and global standards.

Validate design deliverables against project scope, budget, and schedule.

Develop initial project scope, basis of design, and feasibility assessments.

Collaborate with stakeholders to define user requirements and design criteria.

Execute design assurance reviews and health checks at key project milestones.

Identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain design integrity.

Provide expert advice to site engineering teams on design standards and best practices.

Mentor site engineers and promote knowledge sharing across global teams.

Engage with external design partners and EPC firms to ensure quality and compliance.

Negotiate design-related contracts and manage vendor performance.

Implement digital design tools and BIM methodologies for efficiency.

Drive sustainability and modular design strategies in capital projects.

Process Technology

Serve as the global subject matter expert for aseptic processing technologies, ensuring best-in-class practices in project definition and system ownership.

Lead the development and implementation of process technology strategies for aseptic manufacturing, including equipment selection, process flow, and integration with facility design.

Define and own process technology requirements during project scoping, ensuring alignment with regulatory and business needs.

Oversee the specification, design, and qualification of aseptic processing systems and equipment.

Provide technical leadership and support for technology transfer, scale-up, and commissioning of aseptic processes.

Act as system owner for aseptic process technologies, maintaining lifecycle documentation and ensuring ongoing compliance.

Support manufacturing operations by troubleshooting and resolving complex issues related to aseptic equipment and processes.

Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to drive continuous improvement in aseptic operations.

Ensure robust training and knowledge transfer for aseptic process technologies across global sites.

Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes, adapting process technology strategies as needed to maintain competitive advantage and compliance.

Required 
• Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil, or related discipline).

12+ years in engineering design and process technology for GMP-regulated facilities, with at least 8 years in leadership roles.

Proven track record in Tier 1 capital project design, assurance, and aseptic process technology leadership.

PMP or equivalent; LEED or sustainability certification preferred.

Strong knowledge of biopharma facility design, aseptic processing, clean utilities, HVAC, and process systems.

Familiarity with ISPE Baseline Guides, ASTM E2500, and risk-based design approaches.

Experience with biologics, cell & gene therapy, or sterile manufacturing facilities.

Proficiency in BIM, AutoCAD, and digital design platforms.

Global mindset and ability to work in a matrix organization

Description de l'emploi Résumé du poste Le responsable de la technologie et de la conception est responsable : Conception de la propriété et de la gouvernance des projets d'immobilisations de niveau 1 (50 millions de dollars+), en veillant à l'harmonisation avec les objectifs opérationnels, les exigences réglementaires et les pratiques exemplaires de l'industrie. Fournir un leadership technologique en mettant l'accent sur le traitement aseptique. La position assure une définition robuste du processus, la propriété du système et le soutien continu de la fabrication pour les opérations d'équipement aseptique, favorisant la cohérence et l'innovation dans la conception et l'exécution technologique à l'échelle mondiale. Clé
• Responsabilités Élément de conception Établir et maintenir des normes d'ingénierie appropriées pour assurer la cohérence de tous les projets CapEx. Élaborer et gérer un programme de gestion des connaissances pour s'assurer que tout le contenu de conception est disponible et compris à l'échelle mondiale et au niveau du site. Diriger les phases de conception conceptuelle et détaillée pour les projets d'immobilisations de niveau 1, en veillant à la conformité avec le GMPc, la FDA, l'EMA et les normes mondiales. Valider les résultats attendus en fonction de la portée, du budget et du calendrier du projet. Élaborer la portée initiale du projet, la base de la conception et les évaluations de faisabilité. Collaborer avec les intervenants pour définir les exigences des utilisateurs et les critères de conception. Exécuter des examens d'assurance de la conception et des vérifications de santé aux étapes clés du projet. Identifier les risques et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour maintenir l'intégrité de la conception. Fournir des conseils d'experts aux équipes d'ingénierie du site sur les normes de conception et les pratiques exemplaires. Mentor site ingénieurs et promouvoir le partage des connaissances entre les équipes mondiales. Faire appel à des partenaires externes de conception et à des entreprises de CPE pour assurer la qualité et la conformité. Négocier des contrats liés à la conception et gérer le rendement des fournisseurs. Mettre en œuvre des outils de conception numérique et des méthodologies BIM pour l'efficacité. Favoriser la durabilité et les stratégies de conception modulaire dans les projets d'immobilisations. Technologie des procédés Servir d'expert mondial en matière de technologies de traitement aseptique, assurant les meilleures pratiques en classe dans la définition de projet et la propriété du système. Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies technologiques pour la fabrication aseptique, y compris la sélection de l'équipement, le débit des procédés et l'intégration à la conception des installations. Définir et appliquer les exigences en matière de technologie des procédés pendant la détermination de la portée du projet, en veillant à ce qu'elles soient conformes aux besoins réglementaires et opérationnels. Surveiller la spécification, la conception et la qualification des systèmes et équipements de traitement aseptique. Fournir un leadership technique et un soutien pour le transfert de technologie, l'expansion et la mise en service des processus aseptiques. Agir en tant que propriétaire de système pour les technologies de procédé aseptique, maintenir la documentation du cycle de vie et assurer la conformité continue. Soutenir les opérations de fabrication par le dépannage et la résolution de problèmes complexes liés à l'équipement et aux processus aseptiques. Collaborer avec des équipes de fabrication, de qualité et d'ingénierie pour améliorer continuellement les opérations aseptiques. Assurer une formation solide et un transfert de connaissances pour les technologies de procédé aseptique dans tous les sites mondiaux. Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et les changements réglementaires, en adaptant les stratégies technologiques au besoin pour maintenir l'avantage concurrentiel et la conformité. Requis
• Qualités Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie (mécanique, électrique, chimique, civil ou discipline connexe). 12 ans et plus en conception d'ingénierie et technologie de processus pour les installations réglementées par les BPF, avec au moins 8 ans de rôles de leadership. Expérience prouvée dans la conception de projets d'immobilisations de niveau 1, l'assurance et le leadership technologique des processus aseptiques. PMP ou équivalent; certification LEED ou de durabilité préférée. Bonne connaissance de la conception des installations biopharmaceutiques, du traitement aseptique, des services publics propres, du CVC et des systèmes de traitement. Connaissance des guides de base de l'ISPE, de l'ASTM E2500 et des approches de conception axées sur les risques. Expérience des produits biologiques, de la thérapie cellulaire et génique ou des installations de fabrication stériles. Compétence en BIM, AutoCAD et plateformes de conception numérique. L'état d'esprit mondial et la capacité de travailler dans une organisation matricielle

Position Purpose
• Design, planning, execution, documentation and reporting of laboratory experiments and investigations related to process improvements, process changes, alternative raw materials, and deviations on manufacturing process and/or on licensed products, with a focus on fractionation process and albumin.
• Apply state-of-the-art process development tool and methodologies, DoE methodologies, perform statistical data analysis.
• Support compilation of technical documents for regulatory activities.
• Onboarding, training, and guidance of laboratory staff within assigned projects.
• Contribute as SME to projects / task forces and present study / investigation results.
• Collaborate with other CSL internal departments, and external institutes and universities.
• Drive continuous improvement, innovation and modernization of the Lab equipment, working procedure, methodologies.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Scientific and technical leadership of assigned projects in close coordination with the line manager.
• Design, planning, execution, documentation and reporting of laboratory experiments and investigations related to process improvements, process changes, alternative raw materials, and deviations on manufacturing process and/or on licensed products, with a focus on HAB, AlbuRx and fractionation.
• Contribute as SME to global RD projects / task forces and present study / investigation results.
• Onboarding, training, and guidance of laboratory staff within assigned projects.
• Regular reporting of project status to the line manager.
• Writing, reviewing and revision of SOPs.
• Archive all relevant documentation according to applicable guidelines.
• Contribute to equipment calibration and qualification according to applicable quality standards.
• Collaborate with other CSL internal departments, and external institutes and universities.
• Drive continuous improvement, innovation and modernization of Lab equipment, working procedures and methodologies.
• Comply with all safety guidelines and regulations, use safety equipment correctly, and attend safety training.
• Wear protective equipment consistently and replace when defective where prescribed and required.
• Eliminate hazards and risks immediately where possible, otherwise report them to the supervisor immediately.
• Contribute to the achievement of safety goals and actively contribute to improvements in safety and safety culture.

Education
• University of Applied Science, Bachelor, Master or PhD in Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry or Process Engineering (Biology, Chemistry).
Experience
• Several years (minimum 5 years) of practical experience and good knowledge in relevant fields, in particular plasma protein and purification of protein.
• Experience in process development, process improvements and manufacturing investigations.
• Experience with DoE methodologies and statistical data analysis.
• Experience in laboratory documentation, reporting and SOP management.
• Experience collaborating in cross-functional and scientific environments.

Competencies
• Strong scientific and technical expertise in plasma protein purification and fractionation processes.
• Ability to design, execute and document laboratory experiments and investigations.
• Knowledge of process development tools, methodologies and statistical data analysis.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills in an international environment.
• Ability to lead projects and contribute as Subject Matter Expert (SME).
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Ability to train, guide and onboard laboratory staff.
• Continuous improvement and innovation mindset.

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. • Design, planning, execution, documentation and reporting of laboratory experiments and investigations related to process improvements, process changes, alternative raw materials, and deviations on manufacturing process and/or on licensed products, with a focus on fractionation process and albumin.
• Apply state-of-the-art process development tool and methodologies, DoE methodologies, perform statistical data analysis.
• Support compilation of technical documents for regulatory activities.
• Onboarding, training, and guidance of laboratory staff within assigned projects.
• Contribute as SME to projects / task forces and present study / investigation results.
• Collaborate with other CSL internal departments, and external institutes and universities.
• Drive continuous improvement, innovation and modernization of the Lab equipment, working procedure, methodologies. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Scientific and technical leadership of assigned projects in close coordination with the line manager.
• Design, planning, execution, documentation and reporting of laboratory experiments and investigations related to process improvements, process changes, alternative raw materials, and deviations on manufacturing process and/or on licensed products, with a focus on HAB, AlbuRx and fractionation.
• Contribute as SME to global RD projects / task forces and present study / investigation results.
• Onboarding, training, and guidance of laboratory staff within assigned projects.
• Regular reporting of project status to the line manager.
• Writing, reviewing and revision of SOPs.
• Archive all relevant documentation according to applicable guidelines.
• Contribute to equipment calibration and qualification according to applicable quality standards.
• Collaborate with other CSL internal departments, and external institutes and universities.
• Drive continuous improvement, innovation and modernization of Lab equipment, working procedures and methodologies.
• Comply with all safety guidelines and regulations, use safety equipment correctly, and attend safety training.
• Wear protective equipment consistently and replace when defective where prescribed and required.
• Eliminate hazards and risks immediately where possible, otherwise report them to the supervisor immediately.
• Contribute to the achievement of safety goals and actively contribute to improvements in safety and safety culture. Education
• University of Applied Science, Bachelor, Master or PhD in Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry or Process Engineering (Biology, Chemistry). Experience
• Several years (minimum 5 years) of practical experience and good knowledge in relevant fields, in particular plasma protein and purification of protein.
• Experience in process development, process improvements and manufacturing investigations.
• Experience with DoE methodologies and statistical data analysis.
• Experience in laboratory documentation, reporting and SOP management.
• Experience collaborating in cross-functional and scientific environments. Competencies
• Strong scientific and technical expertise in plasma protein purification and fractionation processes.
• Ability to design, execute and document laboratory experiments and investigations.
• Knowledge of process development tools, methodologies and statistical data analysis.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills in an international environment.
• Ability to lead projects and contribute as Subject Matter Expert (SME).
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Ability to train, guide and onboard laboratory staff.
• Continuous improvement and innovation mindset. About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respirator

jobs.description:
Position Purpose
Senior Scientist with high level of experience in protein biophysics to characterize a variety of therapeutic proteins.
The incumbent applies a strong technical background in biomolecules characterization to exciting interdisciplinary projects working in a collaborative team environment on state-of-the-art instrumentations. He/she will partner with other scientists and external partners to develop fit-for-purpose analytical assays, suggest workflows and provide technical support and training to enable critical process decision-making and support continuous drug development activities.
In this position, a high level of knowledge of biophysical techniques is essential to deliver phase appropriate analytical assays and to support enhanced product characterization. The Senior Scientist will contribute to translate innovative platforms and new technologies into fully developed, possibly automated methods.
Scientific enthusiasm, creativity, hands-on lab experience and commitment will be essential for the successful achievement of team and organizational goals and timelines.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Responsible for designing and performing experiments as well as for interpreting results from biophysical and chromatography-based techniques to support characterization of new plasma-derived product and commercialized product.
• Development and implementation of novel analytical methods according to analytic quality by design principles and phase-appropriate qualification according to project and product demands.
• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for biophysical and chromatography related topics to provide scientific input to multiple projects and for the implementation of new technologies.
• Support the transfer of qualified methods from R&D to regulated environment at the appropriate site (QC, CROs).
• Author lab procedures, protocols, reports and SOPs for internal and/or external partners.
• Present at internal and external seminars and conferences.
• Responsible for instruments operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
• Make effective use of resources (time, people, equipment and materials).
• Provide appropriate feedback to other team members.
• Collaborate with group members and cross functional teams to support analytical studies, process development, and other studies.
• Ensure close collaboration with other local and global CSL functions across the proper network.
Education
• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in biological sciences, biophysics or analytical chemistry.

Experience
• 3+ years of biopharmaceutical industry experience in the field of biomolecule characterization by chromatography and biophysical approaches.
• Experience in the development of analytical methodologies for qualitative and quantitative characterization of proteins using different biophysical and chromatographic techniques.
• In-depth theoretical and extensive hands-on experience on diverse biophysical techniques (e.g. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) for analysis of protein structure and conformation.
• Knowledge of sub-visible particles characterization using technologies such as Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis is preferred.
• Experience with various chromatography techniques (e.g. SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) is considered a plus.
• Hands-on experience and knowledge in the operation and maintenance of different types of instruments (spectroscopic, LC instrumentations).
• Good understanding of scientific process, including hypothesis development and experimental design (DoE) with ability to capture and record complex scientific data accurately and reliably.
Competencies
• Strong expertise in protein biophysics and biomolecule characterization.
• Advanced knowledge of biophysical and chromatographic analytical techniques.
• Ability to design, execute and interpret complex analytical experiments.
• Strong scientific problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to support method developm

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto Scienziato senior con un alto livello di esperienza nella biofisica proteica per caratterizzare una varietà di proteine terapeutiche. L'incumbent applica un forte background tecnico in biomolecole caratterizzazione a entusiasmanti progetti interdisciplinari che lavorano in un ambiente di team collaborativo sulle strumentazioni all'avanguardia. Collabora con altri scienziati e partner esterni per sviluppare saggi analitici idonei all'uso, suggerire flussi di lavoro e fornire supporto tecnico e formazione per consentire processi critici decisionali e sostenere continue attività di sviluppo della droga. In questa posizione, un elevato livello di conoscenza delle tecniche biofisiche è essenziale per fornire analisi analitiche appropriate di fase e per supportare una maggiore caratterizzazione del prodotto. Lo scienziato senior contribuirà a tradurre piattaforme innovative e nuove tecnologie in metodi completamente sviluppati e possibilmente automatizzati. L'entusiasmo scientifico, la creatività, l'esperienza di laboratorio e l'impegno saranno essenziali per il successo del team e degli obiettivi e dei tempi organizzativi. Principali responsabilità e responsabilità
• Responsabile per la progettazione e l'esecuzione di esperimenti e per l'interpretazione dei risultati delle tecniche basate sulla biofisica e sulla cromatografia per supportare la caratterizzazione di nuovi prodotti derivati dal plasma e prodotti commercializzati.
• Sviluppo e implementazione di nuovi metodi analitici in base alla qualità analitica mediante principi di progettazione e qualifica appropriata in fase secondo le esigenze del progetto e del prodotto.
• Atto come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) per argomenti relativi alla biofisica e alla cromatografia per fornire un contributo scientifico a più progetti e per l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie.
• Sostenere il trasferimento di metodi qualificati da R&D a ambiente regolamentato presso il sito appropriato (QC, CROs).
• Procedure di laboratorio, protocolli, relazioni e SOP per partner interni e/o esterni.
• Presente a seminari e conferenze interni ed esterni.
• Responsabile per il funzionamento degli strumenti, la risoluzione dei problemi e la manutenzione.
• Utilizzare efficacemente le risorse (tempo, persone, attrezzature e materiali).
• Fornisci un feedback appropriato agli altri membri del team.
• Collaborare con i membri del gruppo e incrociare i team funzionali per sostenere gli studi analitici, lo sviluppo dei processi e altri studi.
• Assicurare una stretta collaborazione con altre funzioni CSL locali e globali in tutta la rete. Istruzione
• Laurea post-laurea (preferibilmente PhD) in scienze biologiche, biofisica o chimica analitica. Esperienza
• 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria biofarmaceutica nel campo della caratterizzazione della biomolecola mediante cromatografia e approcci biofisici.
• Esperienza nello sviluppo di metodologie analitiche per la caratterizzazione qualitativa e quantitativa delle proteine utilizzando diverse tecniche biofisiche e cromatografiche.
• Esperienza teorica e pratica approfondita su diverse tecniche biofisiche (come SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) per l'analisi della struttura e della conformazione delle proteine.
• La conoscenza della caratterizzazione delle particelle sub-visibili utilizzando tecnologie come la microscopia di flusso, DLS, l'analisi di tracciamento di Nano è preferita.
• L'esperienza con varie tecniche di cromatografia (ad esempio SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) è considerata un vantaggio.
• Esperienza pratica e conoscenza nel funzionamento e nella manutenzione di diversi tipi di strumenti (struzioni spettroscopiche, LC).
• Buona comprensione del processo scientifico, tra cui lo sviluppo di ipotesi e il design sperimentale (DoE) con la capacità di catturare e registrare dati scientifici complessi con precisione e affidabilità. Competenze
• Forte competenza nella biofisica delle proteine e nella caratterizzazione della biomolecola.
• Conoscenza avanzata delle tecniche analitiche biofisiche e cromatografiche.
• Capacità di progettare, eseguire e interpretare complessi esperimenti analitici.
• Forte capacità di risoluzione e risoluzione dei problemi scientifici.
• Capacità di supportare lo sviluppo del metodo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgabenstellung Senior Scientist mit hoher Erfahrung in der Proteinbiophysik, um eine Vielzahl von therapeutischen Proteinen zu charakterisieren. Der Incumbent setzt einen starken technischen Hintergrund in der Biomolekülcharakterisierung auf spannende interdisziplinäre Projekte ein, die in einem kollaborativen Teamumfeld auf hochmodernen Instrumentierungen arbeiten. Er/sie wird mit anderen Wissenschaftlern und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten, um geeignete analytische Assays zu entwickeln, Workflows vorzuschlagen und technische Unterstützung und Schulungen zu bieten, um kritische Prozessentscheidungen zu ermöglichen und kontinuierliche Drogenentwicklungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen. In dieser Position ist ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen über biophysikalische Techniken unerlässlich, um phasengerechte analytische Untersuchungen zu liefern und eine verbesserte Produktcharakterisierung zu unterstützen. Der Senior Scientist wird dazu beitragen, innovative Plattformen und neue Technologien in voll entwickelte, möglicherweise automatisierte Methoden umzusetzen. Wissenschaftliche Begeisterung, Kreativität, praktische Laborerfahrung und Engagement werden für die erfolgreiche Errungenschaft von Team- und Organisationszielen und Zeitlinien unerlässlich sein. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten und Rechenschaften
• Verantwortlich für die Konzeption und Durchführung von Experimenten sowie für die Interpretation von Ergebnissen aus biophysikalischen und chromatographischen Techniken zur Unterstützung der Charakterisierung von neuem plasmaerzeugtem Produkt und kommerziellem Produkt.
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung neuer analytischer Methoden nach analytischer Qualität durch Designprinzipien und phasengerechte Qualifikation nach Projekt- und Produktanforderungen.
• Gesetz als Fachexperte (KMU) für biophysikalische und chromatographische Themen, um wissenschaftliche Beiträge zu mehreren Projekten und zur Umsetzung neuer Technologien bereitzustellen.
• Unterstützung der Übertragung von qualifizierten Methoden von FuE auf regulierte Umwelt am geeigneten Standort (QC, CROs).
• Autore Laborverfahren, Protokolle, Berichte und SOPs für interne und/oder externe Partner.
• Auf internen und externen Seminaren und Konferenzen.
• Für Gerätebetrieb, Fehlersuche und Wartung verantwortlich.
• Wirksame Nutzung von Ressourcen (Zeit, Menschen, Ausrüstung und Materialien).
• Geben Sie ein entsprechendes Feedback an andere Teammitglieder.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Gruppenmitgliedern und funktionellen Teams, um analytische Studien, Prozessentwicklung und andere Studien zu unterstützen.
• Stellen Sie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen lokalen und globalen CSL-Funktionen im richtigen Netzwerk sicher. Bildung
• Hochschulabschluss (vorzugsweise PhD) in biologischen Wissenschaften, Biophysik oder analytischer Chemie. Erfahrung
• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung der biopharmazeutischen Industrie im Bereich der Biomolekülcharakterisierung durch Chromatographie und biophysikalische Ansätze.
• Erfahrungen bei der Entwicklung analytischer Methoden zur qualitativen und quantitativen Charakterisierung von Proteinen unter Verwendung verschiedener biophysikalischer und chromatographischer Techniken.
• Vertiefte theoretische und umfangreiche Hand-on-Erfahrung über verschiedene biophysikalische Techniken (z.B. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluoreszenz, FTIR) zur Analyse von Proteinstruktur und Konformation.
• Die Kenntnis der subvisiblen Partikelcharakterisierung mittels Technologien wie Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis wird bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Chromatographietechniken (z.B. SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) wird als Plus betrachtet.
• Hands-on-Erfahrung und Wissen in der Bedienung und Wartung verschiedener Arten von Instrumenten (spektroskopische, LC-Instrumente).
• Gutes Verständnis des wissenschaftlichen Prozesses, einschließlich Hypothesenentwicklung und experimentellem Design (DoE) mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Daten genau und zuverlässig zu erfassen und zu erfassen. Zuständigkeiten
• Starke Expertise in der Proteinbiophysik und Biomolekülcharakterisierung.
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der biophysikalischen und chromatographischen Analysetechniken.
• Fähigkeit, komplexe analytische Experimente zu entwerfen, auszuführen und zu interpretieren.
• Starke wissenschaftliche Problemlösung und Fehlerbehebung Fähigkeiten.

Fonction Chercheur principal ayant une grande expérience en biophysique des protéines pour caractériser une variété de protéines thérapeutiques. Le titulaire applique une solide expérience technique en caractérisation des biomolécules à des projets interdisciplinaires passionnants travaillant dans un environnement d'équipe collaborative sur des instruments de pointe. Il/elle collaborera avec d'autres scientifiques et des partenaires externes pour élaborer des analyses adaptées à l'usage, suggérer des flux de travail et fournir un soutien technique et une formation pour permettre la prise de décisions cruciales sur les processus et soutenir les activités de développement continu des médicaments. Dans cette position, un niveau élevé de connaissance des techniques biophysiques est essentiel pour fournir des analyses de phase appropriées et soutenir une caractérisation améliorée du produit. L'expert scientifique principal contribuera à la traduction de plateformes novatrices et de nouvelles technologies en méthodes entièrement développées, éventuellement automatisées. L'enthousiasme scientifique, la créativité, l'expérience pratique en laboratoire et l'engagement seront essentiels pour la réussite des objectifs et des échéances de l'équipe et de l'organisation. Principales responsabilités et responsabilités
• Responsable de la conception et de la réalisation d'expériences ainsi que de l'interprétation des résultats des techniques de biophysique et de chromatographie pour soutenir la caractérisation de nouveaux produits dérivés du plasma et de produits commercialisés.
• Mise au point et mise en oeuvre de nouvelles méthodes d'analyse en fonction de la qualité analytique par des principes de conception et une qualification adaptée aux phases selon les exigences du projet et du produit.
• Agir en tant qu'expert en matière de biophysique et de chromatographie pour apporter une contribution scientifique à plusieurs projets et à la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies.
• Appuyer le transfert de méthodes qualifiées de la R-D à l'environnement réglementé sur le site approprié (QC, ORC).
• Auteur des procédures, protocoles, rapports et PON pour les partenaires internes et/ou externes.
• Présenter aux séminaires et conférences internes et externes.
• Responsable du fonctionnement, du dépannage et de la maintenance des instruments.
• Utiliser efficacement les ressources (temps, personnes, équipements et matériaux).
• Fournir une rétroaction appropriée aux autres membres de l'équipe.
• Collaborer avec les membres du groupe et les équipes interfonctionnelles pour appuyer les études analytiques, l'élaboration de processus et d'autres études.
• Assurer une collaboration étroite avec d'autres fonctions locales et mondiales de CSL dans tout le réseau approprié. Éducation
• Diplôme de troisième cycle (de préférence doctorat) en sciences biologiques, en biophysique ou en chimie analytique. Expérience
• 3 ans et plus d'expérience de l'industrie biopharmaceutique dans le domaine de la caractérisation des biomolécules par chromatographie et approches biophysiques.
• Expérience dans le développement de méthodologies analytiques pour la caractérisation qualitative et quantitative des protéines à l'aide de différentes techniques biophysiques et chromatographiques.
• Expérience approfondie et pratique de diverses techniques biophysiques (par exemple SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) pour l'analyse de la structure et de la conformation des protéines.
• La connaissance de la caractérisation des particules sub-visibles à l'aide de technologies telles que la microscopie par flux, la DLS, l'analyse de suivi nano est préférée.
• L'expérience de diverses techniques de chromatographie (par exemple SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) est considérée comme un plus.
• Expérience pratique et connaissances dans le fonctionnement et l'entretien de différents types d'instruments (spectroscopiques, instruments LC).
• Bonne compréhension du processus scientifique, y compris le développement d'hypothèses et la conception expérimentale (DoE) avec la capacité de capturer et d'enregistrer des données scientifiques complexes avec précision et fiabilité. Compétences

• De solides compétences scientifiques en résolution de problèmes et en résolution de problèmes.

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead (Northern Europe & UK). The job is in our Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Serve as CSL’s key leader in the key innovation hubs to enhance the CSL external brand leading to BD deal flow to grow our pipeline. These senior leaders will combine ecosystem engagement, strategic scouting, and deal team leadership to ensure CSL maintains a strong presence and pipeline of opportunities across biotech, academia, and investment networks. This role partners with global R&D, business development, and legal teams to strengthen the organization’s innovation pipeline and competitive advantage. The individual will leverage deep internal organizational knowledge, align with the GLG, and internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to position CSL as the partner of choice in the key ecosystems of biotech innovation. ​

Main 
• Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

· Serve as the key CSL leader within the regional innovation ecosystem, actively sourcing opportunities aligned with all TA strategies and portfolio priorities. Create new partnership opportunities for GLG presence within each ecosystem. ​
· Maintain and expand strategic relationships with universities, incubators, accelerators, venture capital firms, and local organizations to amplify CSL’s external innovation priorities.​
· Partner closely with TA Search Leads to conduct regional searches, plan engagements and conferences, and share regional insights and updates.​
· Serve as a senior member of deal teams occurring in each region, supporting transactions from identification through due diligence and help lead relationships with external partners through deal close.​
· Organize and represent CSL at local external innovation events, such as CSL-hosted innovation days, and ensure strong visibility in the ecosystem.​
· Actively participate as a board member in key industry bodies and associations and pursue board or committee memberships to influence industry direction and strengthen networks. ​
· Maintain intimate knowledge of internal organizational capabilities, priorities, and SMEs and engage internal experts to enhance credibility and reputation externally. ​
· Provide insights on regional biotech trends, competitive landscape, and innovation hotspots. ​
· Work closely with R&D, BD, and legal teams to evaluate and integrate external assets. ​

Qualifications & Experience 
• Requirements​

· 10+ years in biopharma, external innovation, or business development with strong regional network and ecosystem knowledge.​
· Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent).​
· Proven track record of enhancing Pharma senior leadership presence/reputation as a partner of choice in biotech ecosystems to drive deal flow.​
· Proven ability to source and evaluate external opportunities and lead deal execution.​
· Strong relationship-building skills with academic, biotech, and investment communities. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

• Requisiti · 10+ anni in biofarmacia, innovazione esterna, o sviluppo aziendale con una forte rete regionale e conoscenza dell'ecosistema. · Grado avanzato richiesto (PhD, MD, o equivalente). · Provato record di traccia di migliorare la presenza di leadership senior Pharma / reputazione come partner di scelta negli ecosistemi biotech per guidare il flusso di affare. · Prova capacità di fonte e valutare le opportunità esterne e condurre l'esecuzione degli accordi. · Forte capacità di costruzione di relazioni con le comunità accademiche, biotech e di investimento. jobs.description:
Job Description
Responsibilities:

• Plan, support, and monitor regulatory affairs activities related to plasma derived medicinal products and human plasma as starting material to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and support current and future business activities.

• Support the preparation, review, and maintenance of regulatory documentation for Plasma Master Files (PMFs), plasma source registrations, and related submissions for the European Union, Switzerland, and international markets.

• Support preparation and submission of regulatory applications, variations, renewals, responses to health authority questions, and other regulatory filings related to plasma and biologic products.

• Contribute to the assessment and implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and emerging regulations impacting plasma derived products, plasma collection, and related manufacturing processes.

• Support regulatory activities associated with plasma source lifecycle management, including new plasma source registrations, maintenance activities, and change control assessments.

• Collaborate with cross functional teams to support regulatory strategy development, change management activities, technical assessments, and regulatory risk evaluations.

• Support interactions with global regulatory authorities and contribute to the preparation of health authority communications, briefing materials, and scientific or regulatory discussions.

• Support regulatory activities associated with U.S. plasma center licensing and maintenance activities, including coordination of documentation and support for regulatory inspections and submissions.

• Contribute to scientific and technical regulatory evaluations related to plasma collection, plasma manufacturing processes, and biologic product lifecycle management.

• Monitor regulatory developments and advise management and project teams on the potential impact of new or changing regulations on business activities and regulatory strategies.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, regulatory agencies, and external partners.

• Support development of consistent roles, work processes, regulatory procedures, and documentation practices across global regulatory activities.

• Regulatory system data entry, maintenance, and management of regulatory information and documentation within applicable systems.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor degree in a Life Science or related scientific discipline required. Advanced degree in a Life Science (PhD, MD) or Regulatory Affairs related field an advantage.

• 3+ years regulatory experience in the pharmaceutical, biologics, or biotechnology industry. Experience with biologics, plasma derived medicinal products, or blood/plasma related regulations preferred.

• Experience supporting global regulatory submissions and interactions with regulatory authorities preferred.

• Strong scientific, analytical, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a global environment.

• Ability to work collaboratively across functions and contribute to complex regulatory and technical discussions.

Different qualifications or responsibilities may apply based on local legal and/or educational requirements.

About CSL Behring

jobs.description:
Title: Senior Scientist –Bioassays
Function: Method Development, Tech Ops
Reports to: Associate Director, Method Development

Role Purpose:
The Senior Scientist responsible for the design, development, qualification, and lifecycle management of binding, enzymatic, and cell‑based assays supporting biologics and advanced therapies across discovery, development, and commercial stages.
This role provides deep technical expertise for complex bioassays, ensuring methods are fit-for-purpose, phase-appropriate and robust, while mentoring scientists and influencing cross‑functional CMC strategy.

Key Responsibilities:
Scientific & Technical Leadership:

• Lead the development and optimization of binding assays (e.g., ELISA, SPR/BLI), enzymatic assays, and cell‑based bioassays for potency, MoA, and characterization.

• Define assay strategy aligned to MoA, CQAs, and clinical phase, including selection of reference materials, controls, and acceptance criteria.

• Resolve complex assay challenges, including variability, matrix effects, specificity, drift, and biological relevance.

• Drive assay robustness, mechanistic understanding, and biological relevance, particularly for potency and functional assays.
Method Validation & Lifecycle Management:

• Author and approve Analytical Target Profiles (ATP), Method Development reports and Pre-qualification reports in alignment with ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, USP, and EP expectations.

• Ensure methods are phase‑appropriate and support comparability, tech transfer, and post‑approval changes.

• Provide scientific oversight for method troubleshooting, OOS/OOT investigations
Technology & Innovation:

• Evaluate and implement new assay technologies and platforms (e.g., automation, digital data capture, novel readouts).

• Champion continuous improvement in assay throughput, reproducibility, and data integrity.

• Partner with automation, data, and IT teams to modernize bioassay workflows.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

• PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Immunology, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).

• Industry experience developing binding, enzymatic, and/or cell‑based assays for biologics.

• Demonstrated expertise in potency assay development and MoA‑linked bioassays.

• Strong working knowledge of ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, and regulatory expectations for bioassays.

• Proven experience supporting regulatory submissions and inspections.

• Track record of scientific leadership, mentoring, and cross‑functional influence.

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .
