Titolo: Scienziato senior –Bioassays Funzione: Sviluppo del metodo, Tech Ops Rapporti a: Direttore associato, Sviluppo dei metodi Scopo del ruolo: Lo scienziato senior responsabile per la progettazione, lo sviluppo, la qualificazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita di test vincolanti, enzimatici e basati sulle cellule che supportano la biologia e le terapie avanzate attraverso la scoperta, lo sviluppo e le fasi commerciali. Questo ruolo fornisce una profonda esperienza tecnica per i bioassay complessi, assicurando che i metodi siano adatti per gli usi, adeguati alla fase e robusti, mentre mentoring gli scienziati e influenzano la strategia CMC cross-funzionale. Responsabilità chiave: Leadership scientifica e tecnica:
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione di saggi di legame (ad esempio, ELISA, SPR/BLI), saggi enzimatici e bioassay basati sulle cellule per potenza, MoA e caratterizzazione.
• Definire la strategia di analisi allineata alla fase MoA, CQAs e clinica, inclusa la selezione di materiali di riferimento, controlli e criteri di accettazione.
• Risolvere complesse sfide di test, tra cui variabilità, effetti di matrice, specificità, deriva e rilevanza biologica.
• Guidare la robustezza, la comprensione meccanicistica e la rilevanza biologica, in particolare per la potenza e le analisi funzionali. Metodo di convalida e gestione del ciclo di vita:
• Autore e approva i profili di destinazione analitici (ATP), i rapporti di sviluppo dei metodi e le relazioni di pre-qualificazione in linea con le aspettative di ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, USP e EP.
• Assicurare che i metodi siano adeguati alla fase e supportano la comparabilità, il trasferimento tecnologico e le modifiche post-approvazione.
• Fornire supervisione scientifica per la risoluzione dei problemi del metodo, indagini OOS/OOT Tecnologia e innovazione:
• Valutare e implementare nuove tecnologie e piattaforme di test (ad esempio, automazione, acquisizione dati digitali, nuovi readout).
• Miglioramento continuo del campione in termini di produttività, riproducibilità e integrità dei dati.
• Collaborare con i team di automazione, dati e IT per modernizzare i flussi di lavoro di bioassay. Qualificazioni e esperienze richieste:
• PhD in Biochimica, Biologia Molecolare, Biotecnologia, Immunologia o disciplina correlata (o esperienza equivalente).
• Esperienza industriale che sviluppa test vincolanti, enzimatici e/o basati su cellule per la biologia.
• Competenza dimostrata nello sviluppo del saggio di potenza e nei bioassai collegati a MoA.
• Forte conoscenza del lavoro di ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14 e le aspettative normative per i bioassay.
• Esperienza comprovata che supporta le presentazioni e le ispezioni regolamentari.
• Tracciare il record di leadership scientifica, mentoring e influenza interfunzionale. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ . I nostri vantaggi Per ulteriori informazioni sui vantaggi CSL visita Come CSL supporta il tuo benessere | CSL . Tu sei lungo alla CSL A CSL, Inclusione e Belonging è al centro della nostra missione e chi siamo. Esso alimenta la nostra innovazione giorno in e giorno fuori. Festeggiando le nostre differenze e creando una cultura della curiosità e dell'empatia, siamo in grado di comprendere meglio e connetterci con i nostri pazienti e donatori, promuovere relazioni forti con il nostro palo

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titre: Scientifique senior – Bioassays Fonction: Développement des méthodes, Opérations techniques Rapports à : Directeur associé, Élaboration de méthodes Rôle But : L'expert scientifique principal responsable de la conception, du développement, de la qualification et de la gestion du cycle de vie des essais de liaison, d'enzymatique et de cellules qui appuient les produits biologiques et les thérapies de pointe à tous les stades de la découverte, du développement et du commerce. Ce rôle fournit une expertise technique approfondie pour les essais biologiques complexes, en veillant à ce que les méthodes soient adaptées à l'usage, adaptées à la phase et robustes, tout en guidant les scientifiques et en influençant la stratégie interfonctionnelle du CMC. Principales responsabilités : Leadership scientifique et technique :
• Diriger le développement et l'optimisation des essais de liaison (par exemple ELISA, SPR/BLI), des essais enzymatiques et des essais biologiques à base de cellules pour la puissance, le MoA et la caractérisation.
• Définir une stratégie d'essai alignée sur le MoA, les CQA et la phase clinique, y compris la sélection des matériaux de référence, des contrôles et des critères d'acceptation.
• Résoudre les défis complexes de l'analyse, y compris la variabilité, les effets de matrice, la spécificité, la dérive et la pertinence biologique.
• Conduire la robustesse, la compréhension mécaniste et la pertinence biologique, en particulier pour la puissance et les essais fonctionnels. Validation des méthodes et gestion du cycle de vie :
• Auteur et approbation des profils analytiques des cibles (ATP), des rapports sur l'élaboration des méthodes et des rapports de préqualification conformément aux attentes de l'ICH Q2(R2), de l'ICH Q14, de l'USP et du PE.

jobs.description:
S enior Principal Scientist, TechOps (CMC Science) – Recombinant

This role is Global and can be based in Bern, CH, Marburg DE, King od Prussia, PA USA or Kankakee IL USA

Job Purpose
The Senior Principal Scientist is a recognized technical expert within the Recombinant Integrated Product Team (IPT), providing advanced scientific expertise and leading complex technical activities to support product lifecycle management.
The role contributes to the execution of product strategies by delivering high-quality scientific input, leading defined technical initiatives, and supporting cross-functional decision-making to ensure robust product performance and continuous improvement.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities
1. Technical Expertise and Workstream Leadership

• Acts as a subject matter expert in recombinant process science, providing advanced technical knowledge to support complex product-related activities.

• Leads defined technical workstreams or projects within broader product initiatives.

• Delivers high-quality scientific outcomes in line with project objectives, timelines, and performance expectations.
2. Contribution to Product Strategy and Planning

• Contributes technical input to the development and refinement of the product technical roadmap.

• Identifies and evaluates improvement opportunities (e.g., process robustness, yield, compliance) and supports their assessment and implementation.

• Provides scientific input into business cases and supports data-driven decision-making processes.
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Works within a global, matrixed IPT environment, collaborating with Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality, and Regulatory functions.

• Supports alignment of technical activities across sites and functions.

• Engages with stakeholders to ensure effective execution of product-related initiatives.
4. Scientific Oversight and Technical Support

• Ensures application of sound scientific principles and compliance in product lifecycle activities, including process changes and technology transfers.

• Provides input to technical decision-making processes, including change controls, validation strategies, and lifecycle management activities.

• Supports data analysis, process understanding, and technical risk assessments.
5. Continuous Improvement and Innovation

• Contributes to the identification and implementation of process improvements and efficiency gains.

• Applies scientific methodologies and data analysis to improve process consistency and product quality.

• Supports implementation of best practices and innovative approaches within the IPT.
6. Stakeholder Interaction and Communication

• Communicates complex technical information clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

• Contributes to technical discussions and governance forums as required.

• Builds effective working relationships to support delivery of product objectives.
7. Coaching and Knowledge Sharing

• Provides guidance and informal mentoring to junior scientists and team members.

• Contributes to knowledge sharing and continuous development of technical capabilities within the organization.

Qualifications & Experience Requirements

• PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or related Life Sciences discipline.

• Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical development and/or manufacturing within a GMP environment.

• Strong expertise in recombinant product process development, manufacturing, and lifecycle management.

• Experience contributing to complex technical projects in a matrix environment.

• Solid understanding of process validation, technology transfer, and regulatory requirements.

• Demonstrates strong project management skills, including planning, coordination, and execution of multiple projects to ensure timely delivery of objectives.

• Funziona all'interno di un ambiente IPT globale, matrice, collaborando con le funzioni Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality e Regulatory.
• Supporta l'allineamento delle attività tecniche su siti e funzioni.
• Impegna con le parti interessate a garantire un'efficace esecuzione delle iniziative relative ai prodotti. 4. La supervisione scientifica e il supporto tecnico
• Assicura l'applicazione di sani principi scientifici e la conformità nelle attività del ciclo di vita dei prodotti, compresi i cambiamenti di processo e i trasferimenti tecnologici.
• Fornisce input ai processi decisionali tecnici, compresi i controlli di cambiamento, le strategie di convalida e le attività di gestione del ciclo di vita.
• Supporta l'analisi dei dati, la comprensione dei processi e le valutazioni dei rischi tecnici. 5. Miglioramento continuo e innovazione
• Contribuisce all'identificazione e all'attuazione dei miglioramenti di processo e dei guadagni di efficienza.
• Applica metodologie scientifiche e analisi dei dati per migliorare la coerenza del processo e la qualità del prodotto.
• Supporta l'attuazione delle migliori pratiche e degli approcci innovativi all'interno dell'IPT. 6. Interazione e comunicazione Stakeholder
• Comunica informazioni tecniche complesse chiaramente agli stakeholder interfunzionali.
• Contribuisce a discussioni tecniche e forum di governance come richiesto.
• Costruisce relazioni di lavoro efficaci per sostenere la consegna degli obiettivi del prodotto. 7. Coaching e condivisione delle conoscenze
• Fornisce guida e mentoring informale agli scienziati junior e membri del team.
• Contribuisce alla condivisione delle conoscenze e allo sviluppo continuo delle capacità tecniche all'interno dell'organizzazione. Requisiti di esperienza
• PhD in Biochimica, Biotecnologia, Ingegneria chimica o disciplina relativa Scienze della vita.
• Tipicamente 8-12 anni di esperienza rilevante nello sviluppo biofarmaceutico e/o nella produzione in un ambiente GMP.
• Forte competenza nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti ricombinanti.
• Esperienza che contribuisce a progetti tecnici complessi in un ambiente matrice.
• Solida comprensione dei requisiti di convalida del processo, trasferimento tecnologico e normazione.
• Dimostra forti competenze di gestione del progetto, tra cui la pianificazione, il coordinamento e l'esecuzione di progetti multipli per garantire la consegna tempestiva degli obiettivi. jobs.description:
The position will be accountable for establishing the Pathogens Safety (PS) strategies for the project portfolio of respective Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) such as Plasma-Derived Medicinal Products, Vaccines, Recombinants and ensuring that the pathogen safety data packages are executed in partnership with PS Laboratories and PS Support teams. You’ll be seen as a strategic thinker, a leader and influencer within Pathogen Safety and beyond. You will also be responsible for maintaining awareness of external trends such as emerging industry and regulatory best practice.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

· Leads the development and execution of all aspects of Pathogen Safety strategy for respective product platform including requirements for starting and raw materials, virus and prion testing strategy definition, pathogen reduction footprint over manufacturing process and adventitious agents’ contamination control strategies for manufacturing facilities.

· Accountable for delivery of end-to-end overall safety strategies for all projects under respective IPT portfolio from defining pathogen safety measures to providing high quality packages to the regulatory authorities whilst adhering to industry standards and regulatory requirements.

• Provide strategic oversight of pathogen safety measures for all projects under respective IPT including overview of emerging industry standards, regulatory framework in areas of virus and prion safety, IP evaluation and due diligence support.

• Together with PS peers co-owns and maintains Pathogen Safety best practices as well as Pathogen Safety by Design framework and its implementation within the Pathogen Safety team and IPTs.

· Responsible for leading meetings within PS to track pathogen safety work packages and resolve technical issues and scientific questions pertaining to these work packages
· Defines virus/prion reduction targets for spiking studies to be executed internally or externally

· Communicates pathogen safety strategies and respective work packages to CMC leads and IPT leads as required
· Manages execution of pathogen safety work packages through strong partnership with PS Laboratories and PS Support teams in line with project timelines under the TechOps governance.
· If applicable, designs externalization strategy for pathogen safety measures through collaboration with PS support and respective IPT capabilities in a matrix format

· Tracks delivery of pathogen safety packages against integrated IPT schedule and reports progress to IPT as required

jobs.description:
The Director, Tech Transfer is a senior leadership role within Technical Operations, responsible for defining and executing the global process and analytical technology transfer strategy across the product lifecycle.
In this position, you will play a critical role in ensuring the robust, compliant, and scalable transfer of manufacturing processes and analytical methods across development, internal manufacturing sites, and external partners.
You will enable successful commercialization, lifecycle management, and manufacturing network optimization by driving strategic technology transfer initiatives across CSL’s global operations.
Working across development, manufacturing, quality, and external partner organizations, you will provide leadership for complex global transfer programs and ensure alignment of transfer execution with portfolio priorities, operational objectives, and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Governance

• Define and continuously evolve the global Tech Transfer strategy covering established process and analytical methods aligned with portfolio, lifecycle, and manufacturing network priorities.

• Establish and govern standardized frameworks, methodologies, and best practices for Tech Transfer.

• Provide strategic input to manufacturing footprint, capacity planning, and long-term operational strategy.

Global Tech Transfer Leadership

• Own end-to-end accountability for global Tech Transfer execution including process and analytical methods, ensuring delivery against quality, cost, and timeline targets.

• Oversee transfer strategies, risk assessments, and comparability approaches, ensuring validation readiness and PPQ alignment.

• Ensure complete, effective knowledge transfer and documentation across sending and receiving units.

• Provide senior technical oversight to ensure process robustness, scalability, and consistency across transfers and lifecycle changes.

• Ensure integration of QbD principles and control strategies into transfer execution.

• Lead resolution of complex technical challenges, including scale-up issues, facility fit gaps, and deviations.

External Partner & Manufacturing Network Management

• Lead identification, selection, and oversight of CMOs, CROs, and external partners supporting Tech Transfer.

• Conduct technical due diligence and capability assessments for new manufacturing sites and partnerships.

• Ensure external partner performance meets agreed quality, compliance, and delivery standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Ensure seamless collaboration across Process Development, Manufacturing, MS&T, QC, QA, and Engineering.

• Align development, clinical, and commercial organizations on transfer readiness and execution strategy.

• Facilitate structured communication across global stakeholders to ensure alignment and risk mitigation.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Define and monitor Tech Transfer KPIs (e.g., right-first-time, cycle time, deviation rates).

• Drive structured resolution of transfer risks, deviations, and performance gaps.

• Implement performance oversight and continuous improvement initiatives, including digital and innovative solutions.

Qualifications

• Postgraduate degree (PhD preferred) in Life Sciences, Engineering, or related discipline.

• Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in biopharmaceutical development, manufacturing, or Tech Transfer.

• Proven leadership of complex global Tech Transfer programs across sites and external partners.

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, scale-up, process validation, and regulatory requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large, cross-functional, matrixed organizations.

• Strong track record in external partner management and manufacturing network collaboration.

• Excellent strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

• Experience in global, multicultural environments.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics lead

Gestione dei Partenaire Esterni e della Rete di Produzione - Identificare, selezionare e sorvegliare i CMO, CRO e i partenaire esterni che supportano la Tech Transfer. - Condurre la diligence raisonnable tecnica e le valorisation delle capacità per i nuovi siti di produzione e le partenariat. - Garantire che le prestazioni dei partenaire esterni rispettino gli standard concordati di qualità, conformità e consegna. Collaborazione Interfunzionale - Garantie la collaboration senza soluzione di continuuità tra lo Sviluppo dei Processi, la Produzione, MS&T, QC, QA e l'Ingegneria. - Allineare le organizzazioni di sviluppo, cliniche e commerciali sulla prontezza del trasferimento e la strategia di escuuzione. - Agevolare la comunicazione strutturata tra i partie prenante globali per garantie l'allineamento e la mitigazione del rischio. Performance et amélioration continue - Définire e monitorare gli indicatori chiave di prestazione della Tech Transfer (ad esempio, il primo tentativo giusto, il tempo ciclo, i tassi di devianza). - Risolvere in modo strutturato i rischi, le devianzae e gli intervalli di prestazione del trasferimento. - Mettre en œuvre l'initiative d'innovation dans le domaine de l'innovation.
• Requisiti - Laurea magistrale (doctorat de préférence) à Scienze della Vita, Ingegneria o discipline corrélate. - Esperienza estesa (solitamente 12+ anni) nello sviluppo, nella produzione o nella Tech Transfer dei farmaci biotecnologici. - Prova di leadership di programmi complessi di Tech Transfer a livello globale tra i siti e i partenaire esterni. - Solida conoscenza del trasferimento tecnologico, della scala, della validazione del processo e dei requisiti normativi. - Dimostrata capacità di guidare grandi organizzazioni cross-funzionali e matriciali. - Solida esperienza nella gestione dei partenaire esterni e nella collaboration della rete di produzione. - Eccellenti capacità di pensiero strategico, gestione degli partie prenante e di influenza. - Esperienza in ambitori globali e multiculturalisme. jobs.title: Director, Analytical Strategy
jobs.description:
The Analytical Strategy Director is a key scientific and strategic leadership role. In this position you will be responsible for developing and driving analytical strategies that support drug discovery, development, and regulatory approval. The position ensures the implementation of robust, compliant, and innovative analytical approaches across preclinical and clinical development programs, as well as throughout product life cycle management (LCM).

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

Strategic Leadership​

• Develop and lead the global analytical strategy aligned with program and corporate goals​

• Provide scientific and regulatory guidance for analytical plans across all development phases (discovery → post-marketing)​

• Drive innovation in analytical technologies, platforms, and workflows​

• Represent analytical function in cross-functional governance and decision-making forums​

Scientific Oversight​

• Oversee development, validation, and implementation of analytical methods (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, immunogenicity)​

• Ensure high-quality data generation for PK, PD, biomarker, and immunogenicity studies​

• Review and approve analytical study designs, reports, and regulatory documentation​

• Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges​

Regulatory & Compliance​

• Ensure compliance with global regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)​

• Lead analytical sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)​

• Interface with regulatory agencies and respond to health authority queries​

• Maintain inspection readiness and quality standards​

Cross-Functional Collaboration​

• Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, DMPK, Toxicology, Biomarkers, and Clinical Operations​

• Support translational strategy and dose selection decisions​

• Manage external CROs, academic collaborators, and technology vendors​

Leadership & Management​

• Lead and mentor analytical scientists and project leaders​

• Manage budgets, timelines, and resource allocation​

• Build and scale analytical capabilities and infrastructure​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements​

• PhD in analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field (or MSc with extensive experience)​

• Typically 12–15+ years in bioanalysis within biotech, pharma, or CRO environments​

• Deep expertise in LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, and immunogenicity testing​

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and analytical validation standards​

• Proven leadership and strategic program experience​

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and health authority interactions​

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

jobs.description:
The Director Non-Clinical Due Diligence & External Evaluations provides scientific leadership for nonclinical due diligence supporting CSL’s in‑licensing, acquisitions, and strategic collaborations. The role ensures integrated, objective, and decision‑relevant evaluations of nonclinical pharmacology, PK/QSP, and toxicology data to identify development risks, data gaps, and mitigation strategies and to inform portfolio decisions.
The incumbent will further act as nonclinical representative for selected Research programs and support oversight of nonclinical strategies and programs across all Therapeutic Areas.

The role reports to the Executive Director, Head of Nonclinical Development.

Responsibilities and accountabilities

• Leads operational execution of nonclinical due diligence for assigned opportunities.

• Acts as hands‑on scientific integrator, translating expert input into clear risk narratives.

• Trusted subject‑matter lead for nonclinical DD on individual deals.

• Lead end-to-end nonclinical due diligence for individual assets or transactions, from request through final governance readout.

• Integrate input from Toxicology, PK/QSP, Nonclinical Pharmacology, and external experts into a single, coherent scientific assessment.

• Identify FIH‑enabling gaps, translational risks, and regulatory limitations, with clear mitigation proposals.

• Prepare high‑quality DD reports, executive summaries, and risk tables for governance review.

• Act as NCD scientific interface to Business Development and Therapeutic Area teams at the project level.

• Contribute to maintenance and continuous improvement of nonclinical DD frameworks and templates.

• Mentor junior contributors and matrix team members as appropriate.

• Escalates complex or high‑impact issues to Head of NCD

• Chair of “NCD Review Committee”

Qualifications:
Education:

• Advanced degree (Ph.D., D.V.M., or equivalent) in toxicology, pharmacology, or a related field

• Toxicology training, board certification preferred

Experience :

• Experience in nonclinical development (10+ years) with proven experience in due diligence or external innovation, ideally across various geographies.

• Strong understanding of FIH‑enabling nonclinical requirements, particularly for biologics and complex modalities.

• Ability to communicate complex scientific risk clearly to non‑expert stakeholders.

• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.

Competencies:

• Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines.

• Experience in working in cross-functional, multicultural and international teams.

• Excellent communication and analytical skills.

• Experience in analyzing and presenting research results to scientific and professional audiences.

• Strong planning and organizational skills.

• Ability to work successfully in a matrix organizational structure.

• Strong negotiation skills and ability to identify and engage internal and external expertise as needed.

• Good understanding of drug development process, strong knowledge of ICH/GLP

• Fluent in English, oral and written;

The role requires onsite presence 3 days per week.
The role can be based in Zurich, Switzerland or Waltham, USA.

Il ruolo assicura valutazioni integrate, obiettive e rilevanti per le decisioni di dati non clinici di farmacologia, PK/QSP e tossicologia per identificare i rischi di sviluppo, le lacune dei dati e le strategie di mitigazione e per informare le decisioni del portafoglio. L'incumbent agirà inoltre come rappresentante nonclinico per i programmi selezionati di ricerca e supporto supervisione di strategie e programmi nonclinici in tutte le aree terapeutiche. Il ruolo riporta al direttore esecutivo, responsabile dello sviluppo nonclinico. Responsabilità e responsabilità
• conduce l'esecuzione operativa di due diligence non clinical per le opportunità assegnate.
• Agisce come integratore scientifico pratico, traducendo input esperti in chiare narrazioni di rischio.
• Leader soggetto-materia attendibile per DD non clinical su singole offerte.
• Lead end-to-end non clinical due diligence per i singoli beni o transazioni, da richiesta attraverso la lettura di governance finale.
• Integrare l'ingresso di Tossicologia, PK/QSP, Farmacologia Nonclinica e esperti esterni in una valutazione scientifica unica e coerente.
• Identificare le lacune, i rischi traduttivi e i limiti normativi, con chiare proposte di mitigazione.
• Preparare report DD di alta qualità, sintesi esecutive e tabelle di rischio per la revisione di governance.
• Agire come interfaccia scientifica NCD ai team di Business Development e Therapeutic Area a livello di progetto.
• Contribuire alla manutenzione e al miglioramento continuo dei quadri e dei modelli DD non clinici.
• Mentor junior collaboratori e membri del team di matrice come appropriato.
• Escala problemi complessi o ad alto impatto a capo di NCD

• Formazione tossicologica, certificazione di bordo preferita Esperienza:
• Esperienza nello sviluppo nonclinico (10+ anni) con comprovata esperienza in due diligence o innovazione esterna, idealmente attraverso varie geografie.

• Capacità di comunicare chiaramente i rischi scientifici complessi agli stakeholder non esperti.

jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Senior Laboratory Specialist (f/m/x)

Fullltime / Permanent
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
Researches and develops innovative medicines to address unmet medical needs, from early discovery through clinical trials to commercialization. It ensures that all products meet the highest clinical safety standards and comply with global regulatory requirements. The role involves analyzing complex data, managing research processes, and maintaining technical documentation and systems. It also includes designing and implementing experimental and operational processes to support efficient product development and informed decision-making. In addition, the position leads projects and cross-functional teams, overseeing portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Finally, it contributes to the development and optimization of manufacturing processes to enable efficient, scalable, and compliant production.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Supports the team in leveraging technology platform capabilities to contribute to project goals.​

• Assists in the coordination of local and global research and development activities under guidance.​

• Participates in collaborative efforts with other CSL sites and external partners, with supervision.​

• Applies foundational knowledge of relevant scientific disciplines to support laboratory tasks and project execution.​

• Works under close to moderate supervision to meet operational objectives with limited impact on broader departmental outcomes.​

• Resolves routine problems and contributes to discussions on more complex issues with support from senior team members.​

• Communicates effectively within the team, sharing relevant information and adhering to established policies and procedures.

Your skills and experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g., molecular biology, cellular biology, biochemistry, or related field).​

• Up to 2 years of laboratory or research experience, including internships or academic lab work.​

• Familiarity with basic laboratory techniques and safety protocols.​

• Strong willingness to learn and grow within a collaborative research environment.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Overview
Responsible for leading the successful operational execution of global, cross-functional Tech Ops projects of strategic importance to CSL’s product portfolio, ensuring delivery against defined scope, timelines, budget, and quality requirements.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Support the execution of cross-functional project plans in alignment with defined project strategy and objectives

• Translate project strategy into detailed operational plans, including scope, timelines, resource plans, and deliverables

• Drive day-to-day project management activities across global, matrixed teams to ensure timely and quality delivery

• Develop, maintain, and control project documentation, including schedules, resource forecasts, budgets, and risk registers

• Monitor project performance against plan (timeline, budget, scope) and proactively implement corrective actions where required

• Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate critical topics in a structured and timely manner

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information in project management systems, ensuring transparency and traceability of decisions, actions, and changes

• Analyze critical path, evaluate scenarios, and challenge assumptions to enhance robustness and predictability of project plans

• Prepare high-quality, concise project updates and reports for senior stakeholders

• Coordinate cross-functional alignment and ensure effective communication across stakeholders

• Support continuous improvement of project management practices, tools, and processes

• Provide informal guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced project managers or team members

Qualifications & Experience

• Required: Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Preferred: Advanced degree (MSc, PhD) or MBA

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent preferred

• 8+ years of experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry

• 3–5 years of experience managing cross-functional projects in a global, matrixed environment

• Solid understanding of drug development, manufacturing, and Tech Ops processes

• Demonstrated track record of delivering projects on time, within budget, and meeting quality expectations

• Strong problem-solving, organizational, and planning skills

• Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence without authority

• Ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization

• Proficient in project management tools and systems (e.g., Microsoft Project or equivalent)

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

jobs.description:
Position Purpose: Ensure Corporate & External Affairs liaison with commercial and site leadership in Switzerland. Provide strategic guidance and direction to the affiliate and site leadership teams on government relations, policy, and advocacy, enable early identification and mitigation of policy risks, and leveraging opportunities in support of our operations and commercial priorities. Lead engagement with government in support of site operations and commercial priorities, develop a long-term external engagement plan for the company.
This role reports to:

• International Head Policy, Advocacy and Government Affairs

• Commercial Affiliate and Site Management (dotted line)

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Develop and lead execution of strategic plan to drive public affairs, executive though leadership engagement that enable the success of CSL’s operations, business and patient access to our therapies in Switzerland.

• Lead and coordinate CSL company engagement with government officials, industry associations, patient advocacy groups and other stakeholders. Represents CSL and takes leading role in key industry associations and committees. Partners with CSL functions to support external engagement priorities in Switzerland. Partners with Communications team for advancing strategic media relations in Switzerland.

• Lead the development of business-relevant policy updates to senior company leaders, in alignment with relevant affiliate functions and the CEA leadership.

• Serve on Switzerland Commercial Leadership Team, partner and pro-actively collaborate with functional leads, including Therapeutic Areas Commercial, Medical, Market Access, and Regulatory, to develop and execute joint strategies.

• Serve on Bern Site Leadership Team.] Drives strategic site engagement at political level, in partnership with leadership of the manufacturing sites and the communications team.

• Bring strategic insights to shape CEA strategy in Switzerland and International region.

• Is a key interface partner and relationship manager with patient advocacy groups, and works closely with Medical Affairs and Communications teams on patient group engagement and corporate communications strategies and programs in Switzerland.

Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements:
Education:

• Graduate/professional degree in law, public health, international relations, political sciences or similar disciplines preferred.

Experience in Switzerland:

• Minimum 8 years of experience in healthcare policy/public affairs, access or comparable fields

• Experience designing and leading efforts to build company profile and impact with important healthcare public affairs stakeholders at the national and local levels

• Experience collaborating with colleagues at multiple levels of the organization (matrix) to align on and execute shared goals

• Strong understanding of the workings of major government/public authorities and healthcare industry associations

• Experience partnering with patient groups to advance shared policy goals

• Strong, proved network of relationships with government officials, policy makers, industry, patient advocacy, and other stakeholders that are influential in policy formulation

• Experience in biologics, plasma, or pharma products industries preferred

• Experience in media relations or integrated communications campaigns preferred

Competencies :

• Strong analytical skills, including ability to spot risks and draw connections between complex policy issues and business impact

• Strong communications skills, including ability to communicate accurate, succinct descriptions of policy/political developments to senior business and international leaders

• Results oriented & growth mindset

• Strong team player skills and ability to work in a matrix organ

jobs.title: Laboratory Specialist, Technical Operations
jobs.description:
The Laboratory Specialist, Technical Operations designs and implements business experimental processes to enable product research and development. Designs related integrated process and candidate / product team activities and directs technical and operational activities to ensure planned project outcomes, and enables portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Provides and contributes to project progression and reports, as required, to project or program committees for decision-making support. Leads teams in the development of program and project strategy, and lifecycle management planning. Develops systems to support dynamic portfolio management. Serves a key role in portfolio evaluation process. Drives initiatives across research and development units to create fully integrated strategies. Monitors and reports on portfolio status and proactively addresses and resolves issues. May design and develop manufacturing processes for new or existing products, taking into consideration problems inherent in the transfer of technology from research to manufacturing. Develops procedures for the economical mass production in cooperation with pilot-plant and production departments. Conducts tests and measurements throughout stages of production to determine control over applicable variables. As required, will need to operate within the current regulatory and compliance environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Under general supervision, responsible for a variety of routine and non-routine laboratory operations in a quality assurance or research setting.

• Duties may include routine reactions leading to chemical or biological synthesis of intermediates and compounds, researching technical literature, and evaluating processes.

• Uses a variety of equipment requiring a high degree of skill acquired through on-the-job experience.

• Requires ability to set up and operate special equipment following manufacturer's instructions with limited supervision.

• Requires broad knowledge of operational procedures and tools obtained through extensive work experience and may require vocational or technical education

• Works under limited supervision for routine situations

• Provides assistance and training to lower level employees

• Problems typically are not routine and require analysis to understand

Your Profile

• Bachelor's/Associate degree, or equivalent vocational or technical training

• Experience in biomedical research or a clinical laboratory

• Good practical knowledge of the laboratory environment

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

jobs.title: Laboratory Specialist, Tech Ops
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Laboratory Specialist, Tech Ops supports day‑to‑day laboratory operations and technical activities that enable development, characterization, optimization, and lifecycle management of therapeutic products and associated processes. The role performs routine and moderately complex laboratory tasks, generates high‑quality data, and ensures that all work is conducted in alignment with established procedures, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.
The incumbent applies foundational scientific knowledge and practical laboratory skills to contribute to experimental execution, equipment operation, data documentation, and troubleshooting under guidance from more senior colleagues. The role collaborates within an Integrated Product Team (IPT) and with cross‑functional partners to ensure reliable laboratory operations and support program objectives across early development, late‑stage readiness, and commercial support activities.

Operating within a matrix environment, the Laboratory Specialist maintains a safe and compliant laboratory, supports continuous improvement initiatives, and contributes to day‑to‑day technical execution that enables robust product and process understanding.

Responsibilities

• Perform routine laboratory work, including sample preparation, execution of test methods or experimental tasks, and operation of laboratory equipment according to established procedures.

• Ensure timely, accurate, and contemporaneous documentation of all laboratory activities in Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) systems and other electronic data‑capture tools, maintaining full compliance with data‑integrity and documentation standards.

• Support basic troubleshooting of laboratory methods, equipment, and workflows under the direction of senior team members.

• Contribute to accurate and reliable data generation; perform preliminary data checks and communicate observations to supervisors or project leads.

• Participate in deviations, investigations, and change control inputs by providing factual information, supporting documentation, and technical observations

• Collaborate within the IPT and across Tech Ops functions to support development, technology transfer, operational execution, and lifecycle management activities.

• Uphold safety standards, ensuring adherence to EHS policies, proper handling of materials, and compliance with training requirements

• Identify opportunities for improving workflows, documentation, and operational efficiency within the laboratory.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific or technical discipline (e.g., biotechnology, biochemistry, engineering, life sciences) or equivalent practical laboratory experience.

• Up to 2 years of laboratory experience gained through industry, academia, internships, or practical coursework.

• Awareness of laboratory safety standards, basic scientific principles, and good documentation practices.

• Familiarity with common laboratory equipment and techniques (e.g., pH measurement, pipetting, centrifugation, chromatography).

• Strong attention to detail, reliability, and commitment to quality.

• Ability to learn new laboratory methods quickly and work effectively under moderate supervision.

• Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate within teams.

• Demonstrated motivation to contribute to continuous improvement and laboratory excellence.

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. Sintesi del lavoro Il Laboratorio Specialist, Tech Ops supporta le operazioni di laboratorio quotidiane e le attività tecniche che consentono lo sviluppo, la caratterizzazione, l'ottimizzazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti terapeutici e dei processi associati. Il ruolo svolge compiti di laboratorio di routine e moderatamente complessi, genera dati di alta qualità, e assicura che tutto il lavoro sia condotto in allineamento con procedure consolidate, standard di qualità e aspettative normative. L'incumbent applica conoscenze scientifiche fondamentali e competenze di laboratorio pratiche per contribuire all'esecuzione sperimentale, al funzionamento delle attrezzature, alla documentazione dei dati e alla risoluzione dei problemi sotto la guida di colleghi più anziani. Il ruolo collabora all'interno di un gruppo di prodotti integrato (IPT) e con partner interfunzionali per garantire operazioni di laboratorio affidabili e sostenere obiettivi di programma attraverso le attività di sviluppo precoce, la prontezza del tardo stadio e il supporto commerciale. Operando all'interno di un ambiente matrice, il Laboratorio Specialist mantiene un laboratorio sicuro e conforme, supporta iniziative di miglioramento continuo e contribuisce all'esecuzione tecnica quotidiana che consente una solida comprensione del prodotto e del processo. responsabilità
• Eseguire lavori di laboratorio di routine, compresa la preparazione del campione, l'esecuzione di metodi di prova o compiti sperimentali, e il funzionamento di apparecchiature di laboratorio secondo procedure stabilite.
• Assicurare la documentazione tempestiva, accurata e contemporanea di tutte le attività di laboratorio nei sistemi Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) e di altri strumenti elettronici di data-capture, mantenendo la piena conformità con gli standard di data-integrity e documentazione.
• Sostenere la risoluzione dei problemi di base dei metodi di laboratorio, delle attrezzature e dei flussi di lavoro sotto la direzione dei membri del team senior.
• Contribuire alla generazione di dati accurata e affidabile; eseguire controlli preliminari dei dati e comunicare osservazioni ai supervisori o ai lead del progetto.
• Partecipare a deviazioni, indagini e cambiamenti di input di controllo fornendo informazioni di fatto, supporto della documentazione e osservazioni tecniche
• Collaborare all'interno delle funzioni IPT e Tech Ops per supportare lo sviluppo, il trasferimento tecnologico, l'esecuzione operativa e le attività di gestione del ciclo di vita.
• Mantenere gli standard di sicurezza, garantire l'adesione alle politiche EHS, la corretta gestione dei materiali e il rispetto dei requisiti di formazione
• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i flussi di lavoro, la documentazione e l'efficienza operativa all'interno del laboratorio. Istruzione e esperienza
• Corso di laurea in una disciplina scientifica o tecnica rilevante (ad esempio, biotecnologia, biochimica, ingegneria, scienze della vita) o equivalente esperienza di laboratorio pratico.
• Fino a 2 anni di esperienza di laboratorio acquisita attraverso industria, accademia, stage, o corsi pratici.
• Consapevolezza degli standard di sicurezza di laboratorio, principi scientifici di base e buone pratiche di documentazione.
• Familiarità con attrezzature e tecniche di laboratorio comuni (ad esempio, misurazione del pH, pipettaggio, centrifugazione, cromatografia).
• Forte attenzione ai dettagli, all'affidabilità e all'impegno per la qualità.
• Capacità di apprendere rapidamente nuovi metodi di laboratorio e di lavorare efficacemente sotto moderata supervisione.
• Buona capacità di comunicazione e disponibilità a collaborare all'interno dei team.
• Motivazione dimostrata per contribuire al miglioramento continuo e all'eccellenza del laboratorio. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui il prodotto

Zusammenfassung Der Laborspezialist Tech Ops unterstützt tägliche Laboroperationen und technische Aktivitäten, die die Entwicklung, Charakterisierung, Optimierung und Lifecycle-Management von therapeutischen Produkten und damit verbundenen Prozessen ermöglichen. Die Rolle führt routinemäßige und mäßig komplexe Laboraufgaben durch, erzeugt hochwertige Daten und stellt sicher, dass alle Arbeiten im Einklang mit etablierten Verfahren, Qualitätsstandards und regulatorischen Erwartungen durchgeführt werden. Der Auftraggeber wendet grundlegende wissenschaftliche Kenntnisse und praktische Laborkenntnisse an, um zur experimentellen Ausführung, zum Gerätebetrieb, zur Datendokumentation und zur Fehlerbehebung unter Anleitung von höheren Kollegen beizutragen. Die Rolle arbeitet in einem integrierten Produktteam (IPT) und mit funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zusammen, um zuverlässige Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten und Programmziele im Bereich der Frühentwicklung, der späten Bereitschaft und der kommerziellen Unterstützung zu unterstützen. Der Laborspezialist unterhält innerhalb einer Matrixumgebung ein sicheres und konformes Labor, unterstützt kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen und trägt zur täglichen technischen Durchführung bei, die ein robustes Produkt- und Prozessverständnis ermöglicht. Aufgaben
• Durchführung routinemäßiger Laborarbeiten, einschließlich Probenvorbereitung, Durchführung von Testmethoden oder experimentellen Aufgaben und Betrieb von Laborgeräten nach etablierten Verfahren.
• Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen, präzisen und gleichzeitigen Dokumentation aller Laboraktivitäten in den elektronischen Labor-Notizbüchern (ELN) Systemen und anderen elektronischen Datenerfassungswerkzeugen, wobei die Einhaltung der Datenschutz- und Dokumentationsstandards gewährleistet ist.
• Unterstützung der grundlegenden Fehlerbehebung von Labormethoden, Geräten und Workflows unter der Leitung von Senior Teammitgliedern.
• Beitrag zur genauen und zuverlässigen Datengenerierung; Durchführung vorläufiger Datenüberprüfungen und Übermittlung von Beobachtungen an Aufsichtspersonen oder Projektleiter.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Abweichungen, Untersuchungen und Änderungen der Kontrollinputs, indem Sie sachliche Informationen, Dokumentationen und technische Beobachtungen bereitstellen
• Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des IPT und über Tech Ops Funktionen zur Unterstützung von Entwicklung, Technologietransfer, operativer Ausführung und Lebenszyklusmanagement-Aktivitäten.
• Einhaltung der Sicherheitsstandards, Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der EHS-Richtlinien, der ordnungsgemäßen Handhabung von Materialien und der Einhaltung der Ausbildungsanforderungen
• Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Arbeitsabläufen, Dokumentationen und betrieblicher Effizienz im Labor identifizieren. Bildung und Erfahrung
• Bachelor-Abschluss in einer relevanten wissenschaftlichen oder technischen Disziplin (z.B. Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Ingenieurwesen, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Praxiserfahrung.
• Bis zu 2 Jahre Laborerfahrung durch Industrie, Wissenschaft, Praktika oder praktische Lehrgänge gewonnen.
• Bewusstsein für Laborsicherheitsstandards, wissenschaftliche Grundlagen und gute Dokumentationspraktiken.
• Vertraulichkeit mit üblichen Laborgeräten und -techniken (z.B. pH-Messung, Pipettieren, Zentrifugation, Chromatographie).
• Starke Aufmerksamkeit auf Detail, Zuverlässigkeit und Engagement für Qualität.
• Fähigkeit, neue Labormethoden schnell zu lernen und effektiv unter mäßiger Aufsicht zu arbeiten.
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Kooperationsbereitschaft in Teams.
• Demonstrierte Motivation zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Labor-Exzellenz beizutragen. Über CSL Behring CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führender Biotherapeutiker, der von unserem Versprechen zur Rettung von Leben angetrieben wird. Im Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten mit den neuesten Technologien, entdecken, entwickeln und liefern wir innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Bedingungen in der Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechsel-, Atem- und Transplantationstherapie. Wir nutzen drei strategische wissenschaftliche Plattformen der Plasmafraktionierung, rekombinanter Proteintechnologie und Zell- und Gentherapie, um fortwährende Innovation zu unterstützen und kontinuierlich zu verfeinern

The Opportunity

The Senior Manager, Total Rewards – EMEA is an experienced compensation professional and recognized subject matter expert within CSL’s Total Rewards organization. In this role, you will provide advanced professional expertise and consultative compensation support across the EMEA region, partnering closely with HR Business Partners, business leaders, and global Total Rewards colleagues.

This position supports the planning, design, and execution of compensation programs across diverse and complex labor markets. You will lead sophisticated analytical work—such as job evaluation, market pricing, salary structure management, and survey participation—while ensuring alignment with global reward strategies, regional business priorities, and local regulatory requirements. Acting as a key connector between global strategy and regional execution, you will help enable sound, competitive, and compliant reward decisions across EMEA.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a trusted compensation subject matter expert for HR Business Partners and business leaders across EMEA, providing consultative guidance on complex reward topics.

• Support regional compensation planning and execution, including base pay, incentives, hiring offers, retention scenarios, and ad‑hoc business needs, in line with global frameworks and local market practices.

• Implement and maintain compensation programs across EMEA, balancing local requirements with global standards and governance.

• Deliver advanced compensation analytics—such as market benchmarking, equity reviews, pay positioning, and scenario modelling—and translate insights into practical recommendations.

• Prepare clear and well‑structured analytical and presentation materials to support compensation discussions and decision‑making.

• Partner with the Regional Total Rewards Lead and Global Compensation, Benefits, and Equity teams on enterprise‑wide initiatives and Workday‑driven processes.

• Support job evaluation, leveling, and job architecture activities aligned with CSL’s Career Framework.

• Provide compensation input to organizational changes and growth initiatives, support pay transparency readiness across EMEA, and ensure compliance with internal policies, governance standards, and local labor laws, while building effective stakeholder relationships.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• 7+ years of progressive experience in Compensation within a medium to large, complex multinational organization, ideally with EMEA exposure, and a strong foundation in job architecture, market pricing, salary structures, and incentive support.

• Solid understanding of the broader Total Rewards and benefits landscape; consulting or advisory experience (internal or external) is highly desirable.

• Sound business acumen with the ability to interpret compensation topics within a broader organizational and commercial context.

• Strong analytical capability, with experience translating complex market, financial, and internal data into clear, practical insights and recommendations.

jobs.title: Global Product Leader
jobs.description:
Global Product Leader
Some roles exist to manage processes. This one exists to make consequential decisions about medicines that matter to patients with serious diseases — and to ensure those decisions are made well, at pace, and with the full weight of evidence behind them.
CSL Behring is seeking a Global Product Leader (GPL) to take end-to-end ownership of a late-stage development asset, from late research transition through development, commercialization, and lifecycle management. The accountability is real: for strategy, for delivery, and for the value the asset creates across its lifetime.

The Role
As GPL, you will sit on the Therapeutic Area Leadership Team and represent the asset at CSL's most senior governance forums. You will lead a global, cross-functional Product Strategy Team — bringing together clinical, regulatory, commercial, manufacturing, and scientific expertise into a coherent, executable plan. You will own the asset strategy, drive it through governance with clear, well-framed recommendations, and ensure the organization moves decisively when decisions are needed.
The scope is broad. You will integrate competitive intelligence, payer dynamics, patient insights, and evolving clinical data into strategic trade-offs. You will lead lifecycle value creation — label expansions, new indications, geographic reach. You will represent CSL externally, including in due diligence and partnership contexts. Your thinking will be tested by people who know the science, the market, and the economics — and it needs to hold up.
Leadership here means influence rather than line authority: building alignment across functions and sustaining it through organizational complexity, competing priorities, and the inevitable turbulence of long development programs.

What You'll Be Responsible For
You will own the Product Strategy Plan and keep it current as data and conditions evolve — balancing honest advocacy for the asset with the objectivity to adjust when the evidence calls for it. You will prepare governance bodies to make good decisions by giving them well-structured options, clear trade-offs, and a recommendation you're willing to defend. You will anticipate risks and surface them early, rather than letting surprises reach the wrong moment.
You will shape a team culture where problems are raised before they escalate, accountability is shared, and the work moves with both strategic clarity and execution discipline. You will contribute to building the next generation of product leaders at CSL and to the continued development of the GPL function itself.

What We're Looking For
You likely have 12 or more years in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical development, with experience that spans the value chain — from late research or early clinical stages through to commercialization or market access. You have owned an asset in a meaningful sense: responsible for its direction and outcomes, not just its coordination.
You can hold a position under pressure and revise it when the data warrant. You can read a complex situation — scientific, organizational, commercial — and turn it into a clear narrative and a plan that people will follow.
An advanced degree is required; a PhD, MD, PharmD, or MBA is preferred. Therapeutic area expertise in CSL Behring's portfolio is an advantage, though not a prerequisite for the right candidate.

Working Arrangements
Hybrid, 3 days a week onsite, plus business travel

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. • Asset Manager (oder Mitglied des Asset Management Forums - falls relevant); verantwortlich für die globale Cross-TA-Strategie, Aufsicht und Verwaltung des Produktlabels, die Identifizierung von Ressourcensynergien und die Zuweisung von Lizenzerhaltungsunterstützung zur Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen und maximierten Wertschöpfung
• Verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Durchführung des Produktstrategieplans (PSP) und die Durchführung der Entwicklung, die den 3-jährigen rollenden globalen funktionsübergreifenden Geschäftsplan unterstützt, einschließlich: Lebenszyklus maximization, regionale und aufstrebende Marktwert-Generierung, Wartung von Lizenzen zu bedienen, Patentabwehr und real-world Beweis-Generation

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Global Labeling Strategy
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

• The Sr. Director, Head of Global Labeling Strategy leads the Global Labeling strategy function within Global Labeling, Advertising & Promotion and has overall responsibility for the worldwide labeling strategy portfolio within CSL.

• In this leadership position, the Head of Global Labeling Strategy provides labeling guidance / perspective to respective governance bodies, advocates for CSL positions within the Development Labeling Strategy.

• Coaches/mentors Global Labeling Sr. Strategists in strategic thinking, technical and leadership attributes. As the business owner for the labeling strategy review/approval process, the Head of Global Labeling Strategy ensures the optimal development / implementation of processes and supports revisions to these processes to enable continuous improvement.

• Due to the global nature of the position, the Head of Global Labeling Strategy engages cross-functionally with key stakeholders in Global Regulatory Affairs and Safety, Clinical Research, Commercial Development, Medical Affairs and Market Access to ensure business critical objectives are met and scientific, regulatory compliant labeling is provided to Health Care Professionals.

The Role:

• Works closely with the TA Heads, GRA GRS to maintain an effective, globally-minded, Global Regulatory Affairs and Safety organization that is focused on utilizing creative problem-solving skills, can clearly articulate the science / regulatory perspective to stakeholders, and contributes to the overall TA Strategy for each TA.

• Establishes a high performing, global culture and organizational model that facilitates the creation and maintenance of scientifically-sound, regulatory-compliant core and local labeling for CSL’s product portfolio.

• Manages a team of global labeling strategy professionals at CSL facilities, such as in the USA, Switzerland and Australia and mentors the department in CSL's Leadership behaviors and the “CSL Way.”

• Develops global labeling strategies to enable business objectives while optimizing product benefit/risk information for users and prescribers.

• Contributes and directs strategic initiatives targeting business, regulatory requirements and clinical needs related to product labeling.

• Provides expert input regarding labeling/labeling processes with local affiliates and third party distributors.

• Manages the Global Labeling Committee for the product portfolio.

• Coordinates activities including participation in internal and external labeling-related audits, ensuring labeling adheres to company SOPs and regulatory requirements.

• Represents CSL at industry associations, conferences and health authorities to promote the CSL strategic labeling perspective. Utilizing this network, brings 'best in class' labeling strategy approaches and regulatory intelligence to CSL and is abreast of current global labeling trends.

• As needed, represents Global Labeling at the Global Safety Committee (GSC).

• Ensures processes supporting generation and modification of Development Company Core Data Sheets (dCCDS) and Company Core Data Sheets (CCDS) enable timely communication and roll-out of information about changes to core product labels, in particular changes related to safety information.

Skills & Experience:

• At least 10 years of regulatory experience, with focus on global labeling strategy, and previous managerial experience (7+ years). Overall pharmaceutical /industry experience should exceed 15 years.

• Broad knowledge of and experience with regulatory product labeling requirements and risk minimization

• Experience working in a complex and matrix environment is required

• Demonstrated experience in working with multiple stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to lead, influence and motivate a cross-cultural team

• Able to think strategically and develop innovative global labeling strategies

• Leadership ability with demonstrated problem solving and decision making skills

• Strong team p
